screens: 4-tile metric strip (Open actions / SLA risk / ROSE / Accounts)

cases.title: Today tab is the default landing screen immediately after login
cases.preconditions: Pulse Field App installed on iOS simulator; valid field-rep (TM) credentials; device online against https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com
cases.steps: 1. Launch the app from a logged-out state. 2. On the login screen enter QA-E2E-tm@dynamicaqs.test credentials and tap Sign in. 3. Observe the first screen rendered after authentication. 4. Confirm the bottom tab bar highlights the Today (house) tab.
cases.expectedResult: The first screen after login is the Today tab. The Pulse logo, a 'Today' hero card showing the user's display name and role label, and the Today bottom tab is active. No splash/rerouting to another tab.

cases.title: No rerouting away from Today on subsequent app opens (warm + cold start)
cases.preconditions: User already authenticated; session token still valid
cases.steps: 1. From Today, tap the Route tab, then the More tab. 2. Background the app (swipe up / Home). 3. Foreground the app again from the app switcher. 4. Note which tab is shown. 5. Force-quit the app, relaunch it cold. 6. Note which tab is shown after the session restores.
cases.expectedResult: On warm foreground the app keeps the last tab the user was on (no forced reroute). On cold relaunch with a valid session the app opens directly on the Today tab without showing the login screen and without rerouting through any other tab.

cases.title: Exactly one ranked Start here card is shown per session
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with at least one urgent lead, one due ROSE site, and no phone drafts so multiple candidate actions exist
cases.steps: 1. Open the Today tab. 2. Scroll to the 'Start here' section. 3. Count the cards rendered under the 'Start here' SectionTitle.
cases.expectedResult: Exactly one Next-action card is visible under 'Start here'. The card has an eyebrow, title, detail line, a source pill, and a single primary action button. The highest-priority candidate (e.g. urgent lead / route checkout / due ROSE) wins; no second card is stacked.

cases.title: Tapping the Start here card navigates to the relevant flow
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM; Start here card resolves to a known target (e.g. lead_urgent → /leads, consignment_due → /consignment, route_checkout → /route, sync_retry → /sync-status)
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Read the Start here card title and primary button label. 3. Tap the primary button on the card. 4. Observe the destination screen.
cases.expectedResult: The app routes (router.push) to the action's targetHref matching the card kind: a lead action opens the Lead inbox, a consignment action opens Consignment, a route checkout opens Route, a sync action opens Sync Status. The back stack lets the user return to Today.

cases.title: Start here falls back to 'Plan the next stop' when no urgent work exists
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with an empty queue: no urgent/SLA leads, no due ROSE, no training due, no phone drafts
cases.steps: 1. Sign in as a TM whose territory has no outstanding actions. 2. Open Today. 3. Read the Start here card.
cases.expectedResult: The card shows the clean 'Plan the next stop' all-clear action ('No urgent CRM action is blocking this session') with an 'Open route' button targeting /route, in an active (non-alarming) tone. No empty or broken card is rendered.

cases.title: All four metric tiles render with values (Open actions / SLA risk / ROSE / Accounts)
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with live CRM data loaded
cases.steps: 1. Open Today and wait for the loading indicator to clear. 2. Scroll to the metric strip below 'Today's priorities'. 3. Read each of the four tiles.
cases.expectedResult: Four MetricCards are present in order: Open actions (value + 'N urgent' detail), SLA risk (count + breach/no-breach detail), ROSE (site count + overdue/work-items detail), Accounts (count + 'N active in this view'). Each shows a numeric value and a detail subtext; values are tabular numerals.

cases.title: Nearby accounts section loads independently and shows up to 3 account cards
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM whose territory has 3 or more accounts
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Scroll to the 'Accounts nearby' section. 3. Count and read the account cards. 4. Tap the first account card.
cases.expectedResult: The 'Accounts nearby' section shows up to 3 AccountCards (initials avatar, name, status pill). It loads on its own even if other sections are slow. Tapping a card navigates to /account/[id] detail.

cases.title: Today's priorities shows up to 3 priority lead cards
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with at least 3 leads in the queue
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Scroll to 'Today's priorities'. 3. Count the LeadCards. 4. Tap one lead card.
cases.expectedResult: Up to 3 LeadCards render under 'Today's priorities'. Each card is tappable and navigates to the lead detail. The 'Start with the oldest urgent follow-up' detail copy is shown.

cases.title: Empty leads state shows guidance instead of a blank section
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM whose territory currently returns zero leads (load complete)
cases.steps: 1. Sign in as a TM with no priority leads. 2. Open Today and wait for loading to finish. 3. Read the 'Today's priorities' area.
cases.expectedResult: An EmptyState card is shown: title 'No priority leads right now' with detail telling the user to refresh after the next connection and to ask their RD to confirm territory access. The section is not blank and does not show a spinner indefinitely.

cases.feature: Live CRM data panel — per-section status
cases.title: Live CRM data panel reports section-level ready/partial/failed status
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM; all live sections succeed
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Scroll to the 'Live CRM data' card below the metric strip. 3. Read the overall pill and each per-section chip (Leads, Accounts, Lead queue, Consignment sites, Consignment work, Training sessions).
cases.expectedResult: The card shows an overall pill of 'ready' (active tone) with the message 'Live CRM connection is working...'. Each section chip shows its label and either a count or 'failed'. When all are loaded the overall is 'ready'.

cases.feature: Live CRM data panel — degrade independently
cases.title: A single failing endpoint shows partial status and never blanks the workspace
cases.preconditions: Ability to make exactly one endpoint fail (e.g. block /consignment or /leads at the network proxy / Charles map-local) while others succeed
cases.steps: 1. Configure the proxy to return 500 for the consignment-sites endpoint only. 2. Open Today and pull a Refresh Today. 3. Read the Live CRM data card and the rest of the Today surface.
cases.expectedResult: Overall pill shows 'partial' (review tone) with message 'Partial live CRM data. Failed sections: Consignment sites.'. The failed chip shows 'Consignment sites: failed' in warning colour; all other sections still show their counts. The leads list, metric tiles, and nearby accounts that did load remain fully usable. A top ErrorState banner lists which sections could not refresh.

cases.feature: Live CRM data panel — total failure
cases.title: All sections failing shows 'unavailable' with retry guidance, app stays on Today
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with a previously loaded Today; device can be put fully offline
cases.steps: 1. From a loaded Today, open Settings and toggle Airplane Mode ON. 2. Return to the app and tap 'Refresh Today'. 3. Read the Live CRM data card and any banners.
cases.expectedResult: Overall pill shows 'unavailable' with message 'No live CRM sections refreshed. Keep any field updates in Sync Status and retry when the connection is stable.' An ErrorState banner is shown. The Today screen does not crash or go blank; cached cards may remain. Tapping Refresh again while offline re-shows the unavailable state.

cases.title: Overdue ROSE audit count badge appears on the ROSE metric tile when >0
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM whose territory has at least one consignment site with nextAuditDueAt in the past
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Locate the 'ROSE' metric tile. 3. Read its value, its detail text, and any badge styling.
cases.expectedResult: The ROSE tile shows the site count as its value and detail 'N overdue'. The tile renders with the danger badge styling (red value/border) because overdueRoseCount > 0. The count is derived from already-fetched consignment sites (no push provider required).

cases.title: SLA risk tile shows warning badge when SLA breach count > 0
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM whose lead workflow queue summary returns slaRiskCount > 0
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Locate the 'SLA risk' metric tile. 3. Read its value, detail, and styling.
cases.expectedResult: The SLA risk tile shows the breach count value with detail 'N stagnant' and renders with the warning badge styling. When slaRiskCount is 0 the tile shows 'No SLA breach' with no badge.

cases.title: No ROSE/SLA badges shown when counts are zero
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with zero overdue ROSE sites and zero SLA breaches
cases.steps: 1. Open Today with a clean queue. 2. Read the ROSE and SLA risk tiles.
cases.expectedResult: ROSE tile detail shows the work-item count ('N work items') with no danger badge. SLA risk tile shows 'No SLA breach' with no warning badge. No false-positive red/amber styling.

cases.title: Day agenda strip renders up to 5 of today's calendar events
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with 6+ calendar events scheduled for the current day
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Scroll to the agenda card near the top showing today's weekday/date. 3. Count the event rows and read the count badge.
cases.expectedResult: The agenda card shows today's formatted date (weekday, month, day). It renders at most 5 event rows (slice of 5) even though 6+ exist. Each row shows title, time, optional account/lead/location context, and a status pill. The count badge reflects the rendered events.

cases.title: Agenda failure does not block Today (best-effort load)
cases.preconditions: Ability to fail only the calendar workspace endpoint while other Today data succeeds
cases.steps: 1. Configure proxy to return 500 for the calendar workspace endpoint. 2. Open Today and let it load. 3. Read the agenda card and the rest of Today.
cases.expectedResult: The agenda card shows 'No scheduled events today.' (the catch silently swallows the error). No error banner is raised for the agenda. The Start here card, metric strip, leads, and accounts all load and remain usable — agenda never blocks Today.

cases.title: Agenda strip shows loading then empty state when no events today
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with no calendar events for the current day
cases.steps: 1. Open Today and watch the agenda card while it loads. 2. After load completes, read the agenda card body.
cases.expectedResult: While fetching, the card shows 'Loading schedule...'. After completion with no events it shows 'No scheduled events today.' and the count badge is hidden (no zero badge).

cases.title: Refresh Today button reloads field data and re-runs the agenda fetch
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM online; some CRM data has changed since first load (e.g. a new lead added in web)
cases.steps: 1. Open Today and note the Open actions count. 2. In the Pulse web CRM (or via API) add a new lead to this TM's territory. 3. On the device tap 'Refresh Today' at the bottom of the screen. 4. Wait for the loading indicator to clear and re-read the metric tiles and agenda.
cases.expectedResult: Tapping Refresh Today shows the loading state, calls reload() and loadDayAgenda(), and the metric counts / leads / agenda update to reflect the new server state. No duplicate sections are appended.

cases.title: Pull-to-refresh gesture on Today does NOT trigger a reload (button-only refresh)
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM on Today
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. At the top of the scroll view, drag downward (pull-to-refresh gesture) and release. 3. Observe whether a spinner appears and whether data reloads.
cases.expectedResult: Known gap: the Today Screen uses a plain ScrollView with no RefreshControl, so the pull-down gesture does not refresh data. Refresh is only available via the 'Refresh Today' button. Flag as a UX gap if a tester expects native pull-to-refresh.

cases.title: Today's Lead inbox shortcut reaches the lead queue in one tap
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM on Today
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Locate the 'Lead inbox' secondary button under the Start here card. 3. Tap it. 4. Observe the destination. 5. Tap the back/Today tab to return.
cases.expectedResult: The Lead inbox button routes to /leads in a single tap (TODAY_LEAD_INBOX_HREF), so the lead queue is never buried under More. Returning to Today keeps prior state.

cases.title: Header notification bell shows a badge count and opens notifications from Today
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM whose next-action alert/draft state yields a badge count > 0
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Observe the bell icon in the top-right header. 3. Read the badge number. 4. Tap the bell.
cases.expectedResult: The header bell is visible on the Today header with a badge reflecting the next-action badge count (alerts/unsynced work). Tapping it routes to /notifications. The bell's accessibility label reads 'N field notifications' (or 'Open notifications' when zero).

cases.title: Expired access token mid-session surfaces re-auth without blanking Today
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM whose access token can be forced to expire (short-lived token or server-revoked token) while refresh is unavailable
cases.steps: 1. Open Today and load data. 2. Force the access token to expire (wait out TTL or revoke server-side). 3. Tap 'Refresh Today'. 4. Observe error handling and session state.
cases.expectedResult: The refresh attempt returns 401; the app either silently refreshes via the refresh token and re-loads Today, or surfaces a 'Sign in again' path. The Today surface is not left in a half-broken silent-failure state — failed sections appear in the Live CRM data panel / error banner, and the user is guided to re-authenticate. No crash.

cases.title: Sign out from Today returns to login and clears field data
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM on Today
cases.steps: 1. Open Today. 2. Tap the 'Sign out' button in the top-right of the Today header. 3. Observe the resulting screen. 4. Relaunch / re-foreground the app.
cases.expectedResult: signOut() runs, the app returns to the login screen, and field data is cleared (clearData empties leads/accounts/consignment/queue). Relaunching does not silently restore the previous session without credentials.

cases.title: Slow network shows loading state then partial sections without freezing the UI
cases.preconditions: Network Link Conditioner set to a high-latency/low-bandwidth profile (e.g. Edge / 100% loss recovery)
cases.steps: 1. In macOS Network Link Conditioner enable a 'Very Bad Network' profile. 2. Cold-launch the app and sign in. 3. Watch the Today screen as sections resolve. 4. Tap Refresh Today and observe.
cases.expectedResult: A 'Loading field data...' indicator shows while requests are in flight. Because requests use Promise.allSettled, sections appear as each resolves; slow/failed sections show in the Live CRM data panel as partial/failed while loaded sections stay usable. The UI scrolls and responds (no main-thread freeze).

cases.title: Reconnecting from airplane mode and refreshing restores ready status
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM; Today previously loaded; airplane mode currently ON (Today showing unavailable)
cases.steps: 1. With Today showing the 'unavailable' Live CRM panel, open Settings and toggle Airplane Mode OFF. 2. Wait for the device to reconnect to Wi-Fi. 3. Return to the app and tap 'Refresh Today'. 4. Read the Live CRM data panel and metric tiles.
cases.expectedResult: After reconnect and refresh, all sections re-fetch, the Live CRM panel overall returns to 'ready', metric tiles and lists repopulate, and any error banner clears. No stale 'unavailable' state persists once data succeeds.

cases.title: A checked-in route draft promotes route checkout to the Start here card
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM with one route visit checked in (a route_visit draft at stage 'checked_in' in the local queue)
cases.steps: 1. From Route, check in to an account (creating a checked_in route draft). 2. Return to the Today tab. 3. Read the Start here card.
cases.expectedResult: The Start here card now ranks the open route checkout as the highest-priority next action (route_checkout kind), with a button targeting /route so the user is reminded to complete checkout. It outranks lower-priority lead/consignment actions.

cases.title: Today surface is navigable with VoiceOver and has adequate tap targets
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM on Today; VoiceOver enabled (Settings > Accessibility > VoiceOver)
cases.steps: 1. Enable VoiceOver. 2. Swipe right through the Today screen from the top. 3. Listen to announced labels for the Sign out button, Start here card button, Lead inbox button, metric tiles, account cards, and the header bell. 4. Double-tap the header bell and an account card.
cases.expectedResult: Each interactive element is reachable and announces a meaningful label (e.g. account card announces 'Open account: <name> — <status>', bell announces notification count). Buttons and cards are at least ~44pt tap targets. Double-tap activates the focused control.

cases.title: Today layout holds up at large Dynamic Type and on iPad rotation
cases.preconditions: iPad simulator; authenticated TM; Larger Accessibility Text enabled
cases.steps: 1. On an iPad simulator set a large Dynamic Type size. 2. Open Today in portrait and read the hero, metric strip, and Live CRM panel. 3. Rotate the device to landscape. 4. Re-check the metric strip wrapping and content column width.
cases.expectedResult: Text scales without truncating critical values; the four metric tiles wrap (flexWrap) instead of clipping; content column caps/centres on iPad. Rotation re-lays out cleanly with no overlapping elements or cut-off buttons. (Pixel-level iPad verification is a known partial per FR-MOB-009.)

cases.title: TM sees only their own territory data on Today; no cross-territory leakage
cases.preconditions: Two TMs in different territories (QA-E2E-tm-east, QA-E2E-tm-west) each with distinct leads/accounts/ROSE sites
cases.steps: 1. Sign in as QA-E2E-tm-east and note the lead names, account names, and metric counts on Today. 2. Sign out. 3. Sign in as QA-E2E-tm-west and read the same sections.
cases.expectedResult: Each TM's Today shows only their own territory's leads, accounts, ROSE sites, and counts. No east-territory records appear for the west TM. Metric counts differ per user. Data scoping is enforced server-side via the governed Pulse API, not on-device.

cases.title: Backgrounding the app mid-load and returning leaves Today consistent
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM; slow network so the Today/agenda fetch is still in flight
cases.steps: 1. Tap Refresh Today on a slow connection. 2. While the loading indicator is visible, background the app (Home). 3. Wait ~10 seconds, then foreground the app. 4. Inspect Today.
cases.expectedResult: On return, in-flight requests resolve or are superseded by the requestId guard (stale responses ignored). Today shows a consistent loaded state — no duplicated rows, no stuck spinner, no crash. A second Refresh works normally.

cases.title: A card number entered in a Today-linked field note is rejected by the governed API
cases.preconditions: Authenticated TM; a flow reachable from the Today Start here card / lead inbox that lets the user submit free-text (e.g. a lead disposition note or visit-log note via the governed Pulse API)
cases.steps: 1. From Today tap the Start here lead action (or Lead inbox) to open a lead. 2. In a free-text note/disposition field type the test value containing a card-like number QA-E2E-NOTE 4111 1111 1111 1111 exp 12/29. 3. Submit the note.
cases.expectedResult: The governed Pulse API rejects the write with a payment-card / PCI guard error message (per NFR-CIS-03), and the note is NOT saved. The app surfaces the API error to the user. A real PAN must never be persisted via mobile. (Use only this fake test number — never a real card.)

cases.feature: Deep link / cold start to detail
cases.title: Deep link to an account detail cold-starts and keeps Today in the back stack
cases.preconditions: Authenticated session; a known account id for a deep link (pulse://account/<id> or the app's universal link)
cases.steps: 1. Force-quit the app. 2. From Safari/Notes trigger the deep link to an account detail (e.g. open the account/[id] route). 3. Observe the screen that opens. 4. Tap back.
cases.expectedResult: The app cold-starts, restores the session, and opens the target account detail. Tapping back returns to a valid Today tab (back stack is sane). If the session is expired, the deep link is honoured after re-login rather than dropped.

cases.title: Bottom tab bar renders first-class daily tabs with labels and icons
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a field role (TM) on the iOS simulator; app cold-started to the Today screen.
cases.steps:
1. Launch the app and complete sign-in.
2. Observe the bottom tab bar.
3. Read each visible tab label left to right.
4. Confirm each tab has an icon above its label.
cases.expectedResult: Bottom tab bar is persistent and shows the visible first-class tabs Today, Route, Map, Calendar, Consign(ment) and More, each with an icon and a short label. The active tab (Today) is highlighted with the primary tint and a soft pill background behind its icon. (Note: PRD acceptance text names Today/Route/Consign/More as the contract; the build also surfaces Map and Calendar as first-class tabs — flag this composition difference to the PM, Q-M-02.)

cases.title: Tapping each visible tab switches to the correct screen
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM on Today.
cases.steps:
1. Tap the Route tab — confirm the Route Plan screen loads.
2. Tap the Map tab — confirm the Field Map loads.
3. Tap the Calendar tab — confirm the Calendar loads.
4. Tap the Consign tab — confirm the Consignment/ROSE screen loads.
5. Tap the More tab — confirm the More launcher loads.
6. Tap the Today tab — confirm Today reloads.
cases.expectedResult: Each tap activates the matching screen, the header title updates (Route Plan, Field Map, Calendar, Consignment, More, Today), and the tapped tab becomes the highlighted active tab. No screen flashes the wrong route.

cases.title: Training, Leads, Accounts and Voice Notes are reachable from More within 2 taps
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM on Today. Training/Leads/Accounts/Voice-Notes are configured as href:null (hidden from the tab bar).
cases.steps:
1. Tap the More tab (tap 1).
2. On More, tap 'Voice notes' (tap 2) and confirm the Voice Notes screen opens; navigate back to More.
3. Tap 'Open lead inbox' and confirm the Lead Inbox opens; back to More.
4. Tap 'Accounts' and confirm Accounts opens; back to More.
5. Tap 'Training' and confirm Training opens.
cases.expectedResult: Each of Voice Notes, Lead Inbox, Accounts and Training is reachable within 2 taps from Today via More. None of these four appear as bottom tabs (they are href:null). The core daily queues meet the '2-tap' acceptance criterion.

cases.title: 1-tap Lead inbox shortcut on Today opens the lead queue (queue never buried)
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM on Today (index screen).
cases.steps:
1. On the Today screen, scroll to the 'Lead inbox' secondary button below the Start-here next-action card.
2. Tap the 'Lead inbox' button.
3. Confirm the Lead Inbox screen (/leads) opens directly.
4. Tap the system/back chevron to return to Today.
cases.expectedResult: The Lead inbox opens in a single tap from Today (TODAY_LEAD_INBOX_HREF = /leads), satisfying 'lead queue accessible within 2 taps from Today and not permanently buried'. Back returns to Today with state preserved.

cases.title: Header bell appears on every tab header and opens the notifications center
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM.
cases.steps:
1. On Today, confirm a bell icon is shown at the top-right of the header.
2. Switch to Route, Map, Calendar, Consign and More in turn and confirm the bell is present in each header.
3. From any tab, tap the bell.
4. Confirm the notifications center (/notifications) opens.
5. Back out and confirm you return to the originating tab.
cases.expectedResult: The header bell is rendered as headerRight on every tab surface. Tapping it pushes /notifications. Returning leaves the originating tab unchanged.

cases.title: Bell badge reflects the unsynced draft / alert count and caps at 9+
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM. Create several phone-saved drafts and/or trigger alert conditions so nextActions.badgeCount > 0 (e.g. save 2 route visits offline and have overdue ROSE items).
cases.steps:
1. With at least one unsynced draft/alert present, observe the red badge on the header bell.
2. Note the number shown.
3. Increase the count above 9 (queue 10+ items) and re-observe.
4. Discard all drafts / clear all alerts via Sync Status.
5. Return to a tab header and observe the bell.
cases.expectedResult: The badge shows the aggregate alert/draft count; when the count exceeds 9 it displays '9+'. When the count drops to 0 the red badge disappears entirely and the bell shows no number.

cases.title: Bell exposes a dynamic VoiceOver label reflecting the badge count
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM. Enable VoiceOver (Settings > Accessibility > VoiceOver) on the simulator.
cases.steps:
1. With zero notifications, swipe VoiceOver focus to the header bell and listen to the spoken label.
2. Generate 1 unsynced draft so badgeCount = 1; focus the bell again.
3. Generate 3 drafts so badgeCount = 3; focus the bell again.
4. Confirm the bell reports button role.
cases.expectedResult: With no count the label reads 'Open notifications'; with 1 it reads '1 field notification'; with 3 it reads '3 field notifications' (singular/plural correct). Element is announced as a button. Tap target is 40x40pt (meets minimum).

cases.title: Switching tabs preserves each tab's scroll position and in-tab navigation
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM with populated Today and Route data.
cases.steps:
1. On Today, scroll down to the 'Accounts nearby' section.
2. Tap the Route tab, then scroll Route partway.
3. Tap back to the Today tab.
4. Observe Today's scroll position.
5. Tap the Route tab again and observe Route's scroll position.
cases.expectedResult: Each tab retains its own scroll position and screen state when you switch away and back; tabs are not remounted from scratch on every switch (expected expo-router Tabs behavior).

cases.title: Pushed detail screen shows a minimal back chevron, never the (tabs) group name
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM with at least one account in the Accounts list.
cases.steps:
1. Open More > Accounts.
2. Tap an account row to push /account/[id].
3. Observe the back button in the detail header.
4. Tap the back chevron.
5. Confirm you return to the Accounts list, not a route-group placeholder.
cases.expectedResult: The detail screen header shows only a back chevron (headerBackButtonDisplayMode: 'minimal'); it never surfaces the literal '(tabs)' route-group name. Back returns to the previous list screen.

cases.title: Every More-launcher action routes to its intended destination
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM on the More tab.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Review card OCR' — confirm /ocr-capture opens; back.
2. Tap 'Sync status' — confirm /sync-status opens; back.
3. Tap 'ROSE audits' — confirm /consignment opens; back.
4. Tap 'Voice notes', 'Open lead inbox', 'Accounts', 'Training' in turn, confirming each destination; back each time.
cases.expectedResult: Each More tile navigates to its labelled destination with no dead links and no route-not-found errors. Header titles match (Review card OCR, Sync status, Consignment, etc.).

cases.title: Director overview tile is hidden for non-RD field roles and shown for RD/exec
cases.preconditions: Have credentials for a plain TM (non-RD) field role and for a Regional Director / executive role.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as a plain TM and open the More tab.
2. Scroll the full More list and look for a 'Director overview' tile.
3. Sign out and sign in as a Regional Director.
4. Open More and look for 'Director overview'.
5. As the RD, tap 'Director overview' and confirm /rd-dashboard opens.
cases.expectedResult: For a plain TM the 'Director overview' section/tile is not rendered (isRdDashboardRole=false). For an RD/exec the tile appears and routes to /rd-dashboard. A field role cannot reach the director surface from navigation.

cases.title: Any deep route redirects to login when not authenticated
cases.preconditions: App installed; user signed out (no stored session).
cases.steps:
1. From the iOS Simulator, with the app foregrounded and signed out, attempt to open a deep link to a tab/detail route, e.g. run `xcrun simctl openurl booted pulsefield://account/QA-E2E-ACC-123`.
2. Observe where the app lands.
3. Confirm the tab bar / detail content is not shown before redirect.
cases.expectedResult: SessionGate detects no auth and !inAuthGroup and renders Redirect to /auth/login. The protected account detail is never shown to an unauthenticated user; the login screen is presented instead.

cases.title: Authenticated user opening the login route is bounced to the home tab
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM with a valid stored session.
cases.steps:
1. While signed in, open a deep link to the auth group, e.g. `xcrun simctl openurl booted pulsefield://auth/login`.
2. Observe the resulting screen.
cases.expectedResult: SessionGate detects auth && inAuthGroup and renders Redirect to '/'. The user lands on the Today home tab rather than seeing the login form again.

cases.feature: Cold-start deep link to detail route
cases.title: Cold-start deep link to a lead detail opens the correct record with a working back stack
cases.preconditions: App fully terminated (swiped away). Signed-in session is stored. A known lead id exists (use QA-E2E-LEAD-001).
cases.steps:
1. Ensure the app is not running.
2. Run `xcrun simctl openurl booted pulsefield://lead/QA-E2E-LEAD-001`.
3. Wait for the app to cold-start and hydrate the session.
4. Observe the screen.
5. Tap the back chevron.
cases.expectedResult: After the hydration splash (ActivityIndicator while !isHydrated), the app opens /lead/QA-E2E-LEAD-001 reading id from useLocalSearchParams and loads that lead's detail. Back navigates to a sensible parent (lead inbox / Today), not a crash or blank screen.

cases.title: Deep link to a non-existent route or missing id degrades gracefully
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM.
cases.steps:
1. Open `xcrun simctl openurl booted pulsefield://account/` (missing id).
2. Observe behavior.
3. Open `xcrun simctl openurl booted pulsefield://does-not-exist` (unknown segment).
4. Observe behavior.
cases.expectedResult: Missing-id route shows the account detail's error/loading state rather than crashing (id is empty so the fetch fails gracefully with an ErrorState). Unknown route shows the expo-router +not-found / unmatched screen, not a hard crash; the user can navigate back to a valid tab.

cases.feature: Bell badge live update after sync
cases.title: Bell badge decrements after queued drafts sync on reconnect
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM. Save 2 route visits as phone drafts while offline so the bell badge shows the queued count.
cases.steps:
1. With airplane mode ON, confirm 2 drafts queued and note the bell badge number.
2. Toggle airplane mode OFF in Settings to reconnect.
3. Open More > Sync status and tap Retry on the drafts (or let auto-retry run).
4. Wait for drafts to reach 'CRM saved'.
5. Return to any tab and observe the header bell.
cases.expectedResult: After the drafts sync to CRM saved, the bell badge count decreases accordingly; when no unsynced drafts/alerts remain the badge disappears. The count never shows a premature decrement before the API accepts the work.

cases.title: Tab and More navigation remains usable while fully offline
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM with Today already loaded once. Enable airplane mode.
cases.steps:
1. Turn ON airplane mode in Settings.
2. Return to the app and tap through Today, Route, Map, Calendar, Consign and More.
3. Open More > Sync status and More > Voice notes.
4. Tap the back chevron from each.
cases.expectedResult: All tab switches and More navigations still work offline (navigation is local). Data-dependent screens show their own loading/error/empty states (FR-MOB-004 degrade-independently), but the tab bar, More launcher, header bell and back stack never become unresponsive or crash.

cases.title: Tabs render their shell immediately under poor signal; sections fill independently
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM. In Simulator menu, set Features > Network Link Conditioner (or a throttled profile) to a very slow 3G profile.
cases.steps:
1. With the slow profile active, tap the Today tab.
2. Observe the header, tab bar and section titles vs the data.
3. Switch to Route under the same slow profile.
4. Observe whether the navigation chrome is blocked by the in-flight data fetch.
cases.expectedResult: Header, tab bar, section titles and the next-action shell appear immediately; per-section LoadingState spinners show while data trickles in, and one slow section does not block the rest of the screen or the ability to switch tabs (degrade-independently).

cases.title: Expired access token mid-navigation triggers silent refresh, navigation continues
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM. Session provider runs a 5-minute refresh interval and resolveStoredSession refresh path.
cases.steps:
1. Stay signed in and navigate across several tabs over a period spanning the access-token lifetime / the 5-minute refresh tick.
2. After the refresh tick, open More > Accounts and tap an account to load fresh data.
3. Observe whether an authenticated request succeeds.
cases.expectedResult: On the refresh interval the provider calls refreshPulseSession and updates the stored auth bundle silently; navigation and authenticated fetches continue without the user being bounced to login while the refresh token is still valid.

cases.title: Failed token refresh clears session and routes back to login (canonical 'Sign in again')
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM. Arrange for refresh to fail (e.g. revoke/expire the refresh token server-side, or block the refresh endpoint).
cases.steps:
1. With the refresh token invalidated, wait for the 5-minute refresh tick (or pull-to-refresh a screen that re-resolves the session).
2. Observe the app.
cases.expectedResult: When resolveStoredSession returns shouldClearStoredSession, signOut() runs, the stored session is cleared, and SessionGate redirects to /auth/login. The user sees the login screen rather than silently broken authenticated calls; messaging aligns with the canonical 'Sign in again' state.

cases.title: Backgrounding and returning preserves the current tab and back stack
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate More > Accounts > an account detail (push depth 2).
2. Press the simulator Home (Device > Home) to background the app.
3. Wait ~30 seconds.
4. Reopen the app from the app switcher / Springboard.
cases.expectedResult: The app returns to the same account detail screen with its back stack intact (not reset to Today). No forced re-login while the session is still valid; hydration splash, if shown, resolves back to the same place.

cases.title: Cold start shows the hydration splash, then routes correctly based on session
cases.preconditions: Two scenarios: (a) valid stored session, (b) no stored session.
cases.steps:
1. With a valid stored session, fully terminate and relaunch the app.
2. Observe the splash then the landing screen.
3. Sign out, fully terminate and relaunch.
4. Observe the splash then the landing screen.
cases.expectedResult: While fonts and session hydrate, a centered ActivityIndicator splash is shown (no premature tab bar). With a valid session the app lands on Today; with no session it lands on /auth/login. The tab bar never flashes before the auth decision is made.

cases.title: Tab bar and content adapt on iPad portrait and landscape
cases.preconditions: Boot an iPad simulator (e.g. iPad Pro 11-inch). Signed in as a TM.
cases.steps:
1. On iPad portrait, open Today and observe the content column width and tab bar.
2. Rotate to landscape (Device > Rotate Left).
3. Re-check the tab bar, header bell position, and safe-area insets.
4. Switch across tabs in landscape.
cases.expectedResult: Content column is capped and centered on the wide iPad canvas (responsive width hook). Tab bar, header bell and back chevron remain correctly positioned and tappable in both portrait and landscape. (Known partial: pixel/device verification of landscape tab bar, hero gradients and safe-area insets is the open gap — record any visual defects.)

cases.title: Navigation chrome survives device rotation without losing the active tab
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM on an iPhone simulator with rotation allowed.
cases.steps:
1. On the Route tab, rotate the device to landscape (Device > Rotate Left).
2. Observe the tab bar and header.
3. Tap a different tab while rotated.
4. Rotate back to portrait.
cases.expectedResult: The active tab is retained across rotation, the tab bar and header bell reflow without overlap or clipping, and tab switching continues to work in landscape. No content is hidden behind the notch/safe area.

cases.title: Tab items meet tap-target size and are announced by VoiceOver
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM. Enable VoiceOver on the simulator.
cases.steps:
1. With VoiceOver on, swipe focus across each bottom tab item.
2. Listen to the announced label and selected state for the active tab.
3. Double-tap to activate a tab.
4. Visually confirm each tab hit area (min ~44pt height; tab bar minHeight is 66).
cases.expectedResult: Each tab is announced with its label (Today, Route, Map, Calendar, Consign, More) and selected/not-selected state; double-tap activates it. Tap targets meet the 44pt minimum (tab bar minHeight 66 with 8pt top padding). No unlabeled tab.

cases.title: Tab labels and More tiles remain legible at large Dynamic Type
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM. Set a large text size (Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Larger Text, near max).
cases.steps:
1. Apply a large Dynamic Type setting.
2. Open Today and read the tab labels (fontSize 10).
3. Open More and read the tile titles and details.
cases.expectedResult: More tiles' titles/details scale and remain readable without truncating critical words; the fixed 10pt tab labels stay legible and do not overflow or overlap their icons. Note any tab label that becomes unreadable or clipped as a defect.

cases.title: High contrast switch in More persists and applies across navigation
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM on the More tab.
cases.steps:
1. On More, toggle the 'High contrast' switch ON.
2. Switch to Today, Route and Consign and observe contrast.
3. Background and foreground the app.
4. Return to More and confirm the switch state.
cases.expectedResult: High-contrast palette applies immediately across all tabs and headers (bell, tab bar tints). The switch reports switch role with label 'High contrast theme' for VoiceOver, and its state persists after foregrounding.

cases.feature: Open-account link from a field-activity review row
cases.title: KNOWN GAP — 'Open account' link from a field activity review row does not navigate
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM with at least one completed field activity / review row that should expose an 'Open account' affordance.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate to a field-activity review list (e.g. completed visits / activity review).
2. Locate a review row.
3. Look for an 'Open account' navigation link/affordance on the row.
4. Tap the row / link if present.
cases.expectedResult: Per FR-MOB-045 acceptance criteria the row should navigate to /account/[id]. This is marked Not-built (UX-M-001 open): expect NO working 'Open account' link from the review row. Record as a confirmed gap, not a pass.

cases.title: PCI — a card number typed into a notification-bound note is rejected by the API
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM. Use a fake number only.
cases.steps:
1. From the More launcher open a flow that submits free text routed for office/notification review (e.g. Voice notes, or a lead disposition note reachable via navigation).
2. Enter the test string 'QA-E2E-NOTE follow up 4111 1111 1111 1111'.
3. Submit.
4. Observe the server response surfaced in the UI.
cases.expectedResult: The governed API rejects the submission with a payment-card / PCI message and the note is not persisted; the navigation surface shows the error state rather than silently saving. (NEVER use a real card number — 4111... is a test sentinel.)

cases.feature: Pull-to-refresh from Today re-fetches without losing tab context
cases.title: Pull-to-refresh on Today reloads field data and keeps the Today tab active
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM on Today with data loaded.
cases.steps:
1. On Today, tap the 'Refresh Today' button (or pull down if supported).
2. Observe the loading state and the metric strip.
3. After reload, confirm the active tab is still Today and the header bell badge has re-evaluated.
cases.expectedResult: Field data and the day agenda re-fetch (handleReload calls reload + loadDayAgenda); a loading state shows during the refresh; the Today tab stays active and the bell badge reflects the recomputed count after refresh.

cases.title: Consignment tab loads due ROSE sites sorted by due date without manual refresh

cases.testData: QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY (due yesterday), QA-E2E-SITE-MID (due in 2 days), QA-E2E-SITE-LATE (due in 10 days)
cases.expectedResult: The Audit queue renders the sites on first open with no manual refresh, ordered by ascending next-audit-due date (QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY first, then MID, then LATE). 'Due sites' mini-metric equals the number of sites returned.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Search field filters the consignment queue by account, site, TM and territory
cases.preconditions: On the Consignment tab with multiple sites loaded, including QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY whose account name is 'QA-E2E Acme Depot'.
cases.steps:

3. Observe the queue.
4. Clear the search text.
cases.testData: Query 'Acme' matching account QA-E2E Acme Depot
cases.expectedResult: While 'Acme' is entered only matching sites (QA-E2E Acme Depot) are shown; all other site cards are filtered out. Clearing the field restores the full due-date-sorted list.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Parked office source shows a 'Source parked' pill and parked guidance before counting
cases.preconditions: A site QA-E2E-SITE-PARKED whose audit has acumaticaStatus parked/not_required (Acumatica not connected — the default seeded state).

3. On Step 1 of 5, read the 'Expected count source' card pill and guidance text.
cases.expectedResult: Both the site card and the Step 1 source card show a 'Source parked' pill (review tone) and the guidance 'Office source is parked — expected quantities are placeholders. Count fresh and trust your physical count.' Guidance is visible before any count is entered.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Stale source (>24h since last sync) shows a 'Source stale' verify-before-trust warning
cases.preconditions: A site QA-E2E-SITE-STALE whose audit reports acumaticaStatus 'available' with acumaticaLastSyncedAt more than 24 hours ago. NOTE: this path cannot be exercised with real data until Acumatica is connected (see consignment-source-status.ts note), so seed via fixture.
cases.steps:
1. On the Consignment tab, tap 'Start ROSE' on QA-E2E-SITE-STALE.
2. Read the Step 1 'Expected count source' pill and guidance.
cases.expectedResult: Source pill reads 'Source stale' (warning tone) with guidance 'Expected counts may be out of date — verify them before you trust the numbers.' shown before counting.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Each ROSE step gate blocks advance until satisfied (counts → notes → evidence → attest → submit)
cases.preconditions: On Step 1 of a loaded audit for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY with 2 expected lines.
cases.steps:
1. On Step 1, leave at least one Actual count empty and confirm Continue is disabled with help text 'Enter an actual count for every ROSE item to continue.'
2. Enter valid counts; tap Continue to Step 2 (Notes).
3. With the note empty, confirm Continue is disabled with 'Add a short audit note before continuing.'
4. Type a note; advance to Step 3 (Evidence).
5. Advance to Step 4 (Attest); with name empty/attestation unchecked confirm Continue is disabled.
6. Complete attestation; reach Step 5 (Submit).
cases.testData: QA-E2E note: 'QA-E2E balanced count, all items verified.'
cases.expectedResult: At every step the Continue/Submit button is disabled until that step's gate is satisfied, and step-specific help text explains what is missing. Skipping a step is impossible from the UI.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Per-line and total variance preview renders as counts are entered, before submission
cases.preconditions: Audit loaded for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY with line A expected 10 and line B expected 5.
cases.steps:
1. On Step 1, in line A Actual count enter 8.
2. In line B Actual count enter 5.
3. Observe each line's variance pill and the Expected/Actual/Variance chips at the top of Count items.
cases.testData: Line A actual 8 (expected 10), Line B actual 5 (expected 5)
cases.expectedResult: Line A shows a '-2' variance pill (review tone) with a variance-preview note; line B shows 'OK'. The summary chips read Expected 15, Actual 13, Variance -2. The preview updates live before submit.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Site with no expected lines presents a single manual ROSE field-count line with no expected total
cases.preconditions: A site QA-E2E-SITE-NOLINES whose scheduled audit returns zero lines.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Start ROSE' on QA-E2E-SITE-NOLINES.
2. On Step 1 read the Count items list.
3. Enter an actual count of 12 in the single 'Manual ROSE field count' line.
4. Read the Expected/Variance chips.
cases.expectedResult: Exactly one line 'Manual ROSE field count' is shown. Expected reads 'Not set' and Variance reads '0' (no expected source). Continue enables once 12 is entered.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: A variance blocks attest/submit until at least one photo is marked as discrepancy evidence
cases.preconditions: Audit with a variance entered (e.g. line A actual 8 vs expected 10) on QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY. Camera/photo permission granted.
cases.steps:
1. With the variance from MOB-ROSE-006 in place, advance to Step 3 (Evidence).
2. Tap Gallery and add one photo, leaving its purpose as 'General'.
3. Attempt to tap Continue.
4. Tap the 'Discrepancy' toggle on the photo so it reads 'Discrepancy evidence'.
5. Tap Continue.
cases.expectedResult: With only a general photo, Continue is disabled with help 'Mark at least one photo as discrepancy evidence for this variance.' After toggling the photo to Discrepancy, Continue enables and advances to Attest. Submit on Step 5 is likewise gated.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Capture general and discrepancy photos via camera and gallery up to the 3-photo cap
cases.preconditions: On Step 3 Evidence with camera permission granted. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Tap Camera; take a photo; confirm it appears with a thumbnail and 'Ready to upload'.
2. Tap Gallery; add a second photo.
3. Tap Gallery; add a third photo (count pill shows '3 photos').
4. Tap Camera again to attempt a 4th photo.
cases.expectedResult: Three photos attach with preview thumbnails and per-item purpose/upload status. Attempting a 4th surfaces the error 'ROSE evidence is capped at 3 photos for this mobile audit.' and no 4th photo is added.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Oversized (>4MB) or non-image evidence is rejected with a user-facing error
cases.preconditions: On Step 3 Evidence. A >4MB image and a non-image file available in the gallery/files.
cases.steps:
1. Tap Gallery and select an image larger than 4 MB.
2. Observe the error banner.
3. Attempt to select a non-image file (e.g. PDF) if the picker allows.
cases.expectedResult: The >4MB image is rejected with 'ROSE evidence photo is too large. Choose an image under 4 MB.' A non-image selection is rejected with 'ROSE evidence upload currently accepts photos only.' No file is added in either case.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Submit is blocked until attestedByName is typed AND the attestation checkbox is confirmed
cases.preconditions: A valid balanced audit advanced to Step 4 (Attest) for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY.
cases.steps:
1. On Step 4 leave the name empty and tap the attestation checkbox; observe Continue stays disabled.
2. Type a name 'QA-E2E Tester' but uncheck the attestation; observe Continue disabled.
3. Type the name AND check the attestation; tap Continue.
4. On Step 5 read any submit-blocker text.
cases.expectedResult: Continue/Submit is disabled with 'Enter your name and confirm the attestation.' until both attestedByName is non-empty and isAttested is true. Only with both set does the flow reach an enabled Submit.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: A balanced count submits with reconciliationStatus true_up_confirmed
cases.preconditions: Audit for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY where all actual counts equal expected (line A 10, line B 5). Online.
cases.steps:
1. Enter actual counts equal to expected on every line.
2. Add the audit note, skip optional photos, complete attestation.
3. On Step 5 confirm Variance chip reads '0'.
4. Tap 'Submit ROSE to CRM'.
5. (Back office / API) verify the submitted reconciliationStatus.
cases.expectedResult: Submit succeeds, success card reads 'CRM saved' / 'ROSE audit submitted to CRM...', the audit card closes, the queue reloads, and CRM receives reconciliationStatus = true_up_confirmed.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: A shortage/overage submits with reconciliationStatus open for back-office follow-up
cases.preconditions: Audit for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY with a variance (line A actual 8 vs expected 10) and one discrepancy photo attached. Online.
cases.steps:

2. On Step 3 attach a photo and mark it Discrepancy.

cases.expectedResult: Submit succeeds and CRM receives reconciliationStatus = open so the discrepancy/PO follow-up stays visible in the consignment work queue.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: ROSE audit saves as a phone draft when CRM is unreachable and persists across app restart
cases.preconditions: A fully-completed audit (counts, note, attestation; optional photo) ready on Step 5 for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY.
cases.steps:
1. Toggle Airplane mode ON in Settings.
2. Return to the app and tap 'Submit ROSE to CRM'.
3. Read the result banner.
4. Force-quit the app and relaunch.
5. Open the header bell / Sync Status screen.
cases.testData: QA-E2E balanced audit, airplane mode on
cases.expectedResult: The submit falls back to a phone draft ('Draft on phone' banner); the draft (kind consignment_rose_audit, titled 'ROSE audit: <account>') is listed in Sync Status with attestation and counts after relaunch, proving it persisted across app close.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Reconnecting and tapping Retry submits the full saved ROSE payload
cases.preconditions: A phone-saved ROSE draft exists from MOB-ROSE-014. Still in airplane mode.
cases.steps:
1. Open Sync Status (header bell or More).

3. Toggle Airplane mode OFF; wait for connectivity.
4. Tap 'Retry this update' on the ROSE draft (or 'Retry ready updates').

cases.expectedResult: Retry submits the complete audit payload (counts, notes, attestation, photo metadata); the draft transitions to synced/CRM-saved and can be cleared via 'Remove CRM-saved copies'. The bell draft badge count decreases by one.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Offline draft preserves photo metadata only, not uploaded media
cases.preconditions: On Step 3 with a photo attached, then go offline before submit for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY.

2. Toggle Airplane mode ON.
3. Complete and submit so it saves as a draft.

cases.expectedResult: The evidence warning ('Offline drafts keep counts, notes, attestation, and photo metadata only') is shown, and the saved draft records photo metadata (filename/purpose) with mediaUploadStatus indicating CRM upload deferred — actual media uploads only on a successful online retry.
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: ROSE lines display SKU/barcode as text with no barcode-scan button (parked)

cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: ROSE submit does not block on a customer/dealer signature
cases.preconditions: A valid completed audit on Step 5 for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY. Online.
cases.steps:

cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Selecting a site with no scheduled/in-progress audit shows a clear guidance error

cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: A failed site-detail fetch surfaces an error without crashing the queue

cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Denying camera permission surfaces a clear error and does not crash evidence capture

cases.title: A card-number-like value in the audit note or attestation name is rejected by the API

cases.title: Access token expiring during submit either refreshes or falls back to a phone draft (no silent loss)
cases.preconditions: A valid completed audit on Step 5. Access token forced to expire (short-lived test token) just before submit.

cases.title: Actual-count field accepts digits only and treats non-numeric/empty as not-counted
cases.preconditions: On Step 1 of a loaded audit for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY.
cases.steps:

cases.title: No due/visible consignment sites shows the empty state, not a blank screen
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a user whose CRM session returns zero consignment sites (or search yields no matches).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Consignment tab.
2. Observe the Audit queue area after loading completes.
3. Alternatively, type a non-matching search term like 'zzzzz'.
cases.expectedResult: An empty state card 'No consignment sites' with detail 'No due or visible consignment sites were returned for this mobile session.' is shown; the screen does not appear broken or blank, and the CRM sync-boundary card remains visible.

cases.title: Backgrounding and foregrounding the app mid-audit preserves entered counts and step position
cases.preconditions: On Step 3 of an in-progress audit for QA-E2E-SITE-EARLY with counts and a note already entered.
cases.steps:

3. Wait ~30 seconds, then re-foreground the app.
4. Observe the audit card state.
cases.expectedResult: On return the audit card is still open on the same step with the previously entered counts and note retained (in-memory session state preserved across a brief background/foreground cycle).
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.title: Cancelling an in-progress audit clears all fields and returns to the queue
cases.preconditions: On any step of an in-progress audit with counts, a note and attestation partially entered.
cases.steps:

2. Tap Cancel at the bottom of the ROSE audit card.
3. Re-open the same site via 'Start ROSE'.
cases.expectedResult: Cancel closes the audit card and returns to the queue. Re-opening the site starts a fresh Step 1 with all previously entered counts, note, attestation name and photos cleared (no stale data carried over).
cases._module: ROSE Consignment Audit (Mobile Field App PRD §7.3)

cases.expectedResult: Expected reads 'Not set', Actual reflects the entered totals, Variance reads '0' (no expected to compare), and the audit submits as a count summary (no false variance triggered, no discrepancy photo forced).

4. Check the Submit button announces its enabled/disabled state.
cases.expectedResult: Each step pill, count field, the attestation checkbox (checked/unchecked) and the Submit button are reachable and announced with meaningful labels; disabled Continue/Submit conveys its blocked state. (Any unlabeled control is logged as an a11y gap.)
