cases.title: Training screen loads sessions and shows scheduled/checked-in/overdue counts
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a field rep (TM) with >=1 scheduled training session in CRM. Online on the iOS simulator. App pointed at https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com.
cases.steps:
1. Launch the app and land on Today.
2. Tap the More tab.
3. Tap Training.
4. Observe the Hero card metric strip (Open / Checked in / Overdue).
5. Observe the 'Scheduled work' list below.
cases.expectedResult: Training screen renders. Each session shows as a card with a status pill (executionState) and scheduled date/time. The Open count = non-completed sessions, Checked in = sessions with checkedInAt and no completedAt, Overdue = isOverdue sessions. Counts match the visible list. Cancelled/no_show/completed sessions are filtered out (isMobileActionableTrainingSession).

cases.title: Empty state shows when no actionable training sessions exist
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a field rep with NO scheduled/actionable training sessions (all cancelled or completed) in CRM. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Open Training from the More tab.
2. Wait for loading to finish.
3. Observe the Scheduled work section.
cases.testData: User with only QA-E2E-TRAIN-COMPLETED and QA-E2E-TRAIN-CANCELLED sessions
cases.expectedResult: EmptyState renders with title 'No training sessions loaded' and the refresh guidance detail. All three metric counts read 0. No Complete-session card is shown.

cases.title: Tap Refresh training reloads the list and shows the loading indicator
cases.preconditions: Logged in; Training screen open with a session list visible.
cases.steps:
1. On the Training screen scroll to the bottom.
2. Tap 'Refresh training'.
3. Observe the screen during the request.
cases.expectedResult: LoadingState 'Loading scheduled training...' appears during the fetch, then the list re-renders sorted (non-completed first, then by ascending scheduledAt). No duplicate cards. Previously selected session stays selected if still present, otherwise the first session is auto-selected.

cases.title: Happy-path: complete a full session check in -> details -> proof -> follow-up -> submit
cases.preconditions: Logged in as TM. A non-checked-in scheduled session QA-E2E-TRAIN-SCHEDULED exists. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Open Training, tap the QA-E2E-TRAIN-SCHEDULED card to select it.
2. In Step 1 tap 'Check in'; wait for 'CRM checked in'.
3. Tap 'Continue' to Step 2.
4. Set Attendees to 5 and type completion notes 'QA-E2E covered install + cure times'.
5. Tap Continue to Step 3 (Proof), then Continue to Step 4 (Follow-up).
6. Leave follow-up off, tap Continue to Step 5 (Submit).
7. Tap 'Complete training'.
cases.testData: Attendees=5; notes='QA-E2E covered install + cure times'
cases.expectedResult: Step pills advance and gate correctly. Check-in sets checkedInAt and shows success banner. Step nav only advances when each gate is met. On submit, 'CRM saved' banner shows, success haptic fires, the session is removed from the actionable list (completed), and selection moves to the next session or clears.

cases.title: Completion fields stay locked until check-in is recorded
cases.preconditions: Logged in; a fresh non-checked-in session selected. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Select QA-E2E-TRAIN-SCHEDULED.
2. Observe the workflow starts at Step 1 (Check in) with no Continue button.
3. Confirm Steps 2-5 are not reachable before check-in.
4. Tap 'Check in'.
cases.expectedResult: Before check-in, only the 'Check in' primary button is present in Step 1 and there is no path to Details. After successful check-in, a 'Continue' button appears and Step 2 becomes reachable. The Check-in button becomes disabled/labelled 'Checked in'.

cases.title: Details step blocks Continue until attendee count >=1 and notes are present
cases.preconditions: Logged in; selected session already checked in; on Step 2 (Details).
cases.steps:
1. Clear the Attendees field (leave 0/empty).
2. Leave Completion notes empty.
3. Observe the Continue button and helper text.
4. Type only notes, leave attendees 0; observe.
5. Set attendees 3, clear notes; observe.
6. Set attendees 3 and notes 'QA-E2E note'; observe.
cases.expectedResult: Continue is disabled while attendees<1 OR notes empty, and the helper 'Add attendee count and completion notes to continue.' shows. Continue enables only when attendee count is a finite integer >0 AND trimmed notes are non-empty.

cases.title: Attendee field accepts only numeric input (number-pad) and rejects zero on submit
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session; on Step 2.
cases.steps:
1. Tap the Attendees field and confirm the number-pad keyboard appears.
2. Attempt to type letters/symbols.
3. Set attendees to 0, fill notes, advance to Submit, tap 'Complete training'.
cases.expectedResult: Only digits are entered (number-pad keyboard). With attendees 0 the completion blocker 'Enter at least 1 attendee.' is shown and Complete is disabled; submit does not fire.

cases.title: Capture a proof photo with the camera and confirm it uploads and counts
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session selected; on Step 3 (Proof). Camera permission not yet decided. Online.
cases.steps:
1. On Step 3 tap 'Camera'.
2. When iOS prompts for camera access, tap Allow.
3. Capture/Use a photo in the simulator camera UI.
4. Observe the Proof files counter and proof status text.
cases.expectedResult: Camera permission is requested, photo is taken, upload runs (button shows 'Uploading...'), success status '<fileName> uploaded for review.' appears, proof count increments (e.g. 1/3), and the Submit step shows the new Proof count. Light haptic fires.

cases.title: Attach a proof photo from the photo library
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session; on Step 3. At least one image in the simulator photo library. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Gallery'.
2. Pick an image from the library.
3. Observe the proof status and counter.
cases.expectedResult: Image library opens, selected image uploads, success status shows, and the proof count increments. The image carries to the Submit summary Proof chip.

cases.title: Proof upload is capped at 3 files and rejects images over 4 MB
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session with already-uploaded proof attachments. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Upload proof photos until the count reaches 3/3.
2. Observe the Camera and Gallery buttons.
3. (Separate run) Attempt to attach an image larger than 4 MB.
cases.expectedResult: At 3/3 both Camera and Gallery buttons are disabled and the helper notes the 3-image / 4 MB cap. Attempting a >4 MB image surfaces 'Training proof photo is too large. Choose an image under 4 MB.' and no upload occurs.

cases.title: Non-photo proof selection is rejected
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session; on Step 3. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Tap Gallery and select a non-image asset / file whose mime type is not image/* (if reachable on the simulator).
2. Observe the proof status.
cases.expectedResult: Upload is rejected with 'Training proof upload currently accepts photos only.' as an error-tone proof status; proof count does not change.

cases.title: Failed proof upload blocks submit unless proof notes are provided
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session; on Step 3.
cases.steps:
1. Toggle airplane mode ON in Settings.
2. Return to the app and tap 'Camera' (or Gallery), capture/pick a photo.
3. Observe the proof status.
4. Advance to Submit and try 'Complete training' with proof notes empty.
5. Go back to Step 3, add proof notes 'QA-E2E proof kept in dealer binder', return to Submit and complete.
cases.testData: Proof notes='QA-E2E proof kept in dealer binder'
cases.expectedResult: Proof upload fails with the not-uploaded/not-saved-offline error status. At Submit the blocker 'Proof photo was not uploaded. Retry the photo or add proof notes before saving.' prevents completion until proof notes are entered. Once proof notes are present (and online), completion proceeds.

cases.title: Create an inline follow-up task at completion
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session with valid attendees+notes; on Step 4 (Follow-up). Online.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Add follow-up task'.
2. Enter Task title 'QA-E2E send recap' and Task detail 'Email recap to dealer by Friday'.
3. Continue to Submit (Follow-up chip = yes) and tap 'Complete training'.
cases.testData: title='QA-E2E send recap'; detail='Email recap to dealer by Friday'
cases.expectedResult: Follow-up panel expands, the Submit summary shows Follow-up: yes, and the completion request includes createFollowUpTask with the trimmed title and description. CRM saved confirmation appears.

cases.title: Enabled follow-up with missing title or detail blocks submit
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session with valid attendees+notes. Online.
cases.steps:
1. On Step 4 tap 'Add follow-up task'.
2. Enter only a title, leave detail empty.
3. Continue to Submit and tap 'Complete training'.
4. Return, tap 'Clear', and complete with no follow-up.
cases.expectedResult: Completion blocker 'Add both follow-up title and detail, or clear the follow-up task.' is shown and Complete is disabled. After tapping Clear, follow-up resets to off and completion succeeds (Follow-up: no).

cases.title: Completion saves as a training phone draft when CRM is unreachable
cases.preconditions: Logged in; session already checked in (while online) with valid attendees+notes; on Step 5.
cases.steps:
1. Toggle airplane mode ON in Settings.
2. Return to the app, tap 'Complete training'.
3. Observe the sync/status banner.
4. Tap the header bell and open the Sync Status screen.
cases.expectedResult: Completion request fails to reach CRM and is enqueued as a durable 'training_session' draft. A warning-tone 'Draft' banner is shown (describeDraftSaveFailure message). The header bell badge increments and the Sync Status screen lists the training draft with its saved counts/notes and what it will do on retry.

cases.title: Training draft survives app restart and submits the full payload on retry
cases.preconditions: A queued training draft exists from MOB-TRAIN-015. Currently offline.
cases.steps:
1. Force-quit the app from the iOS app switcher and relaunch it.
2. Open the header bell -> Sync Status; confirm the training draft is still listed with its badge count.
3. Toggle airplane mode OFF (reconnect).
4. Tap Retry on the training draft.
5. Observe the result.
cases.expectedResult: The draft persists across the restart (badge count unchanged). After reconnect, Retry submits the complete training payload (attendeeCount, checkoutNotes, completedAt, durationMinutes, proofAttachmentCount, optional proofNotes / follow-up). On success the item becomes CRM saved and leaves the draft inventory; the bell badge decrements.

cases.title: A session already completed in CRM cannot be re-completed
cases.preconditions: Logged in. A session that is completed in CRM is selected (e.g. via stale list before refresh).
cases.steps:
1. Select a session whose executionState/status is completed (or completedAt is set).
2. Attempt to check in and to complete.
cases.expectedResult: Check-in and proof buttons are disabled for a completed session; the completion blocker reads 'This session is already completed in CRM.' Completed sessions are also filtered out of the actionable list on the next load.

cases.title: Completion note containing a payment card number is rejected by the API
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session with valid attendees; on Step 5. Online.
cases.steps:
1. On Step 2 set completion notes to include a card-like PAN (use a non-real Luhn-valid test value, never a live card).
2. Advance to Submit and tap 'Complete training'.
3. Observe the error.
cases.expectedResult: The API rejects the submission with a payment-card error (text appears to contain payment card data which cannot be stored; remove the card number — card-on-file is handled through the secure hosted step). The completion is not saved to CRM; the entered values remain on screen so the tester can edit and resubmit.

cases.title: Field rep sees only their own/territory-scoped training sessions
cases.preconditions: Two users: a field TM and another rep with sessions in a different territory. Logged in as the field TM. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Open Training as the field TM.
2. Review the session list.
3. Confirm no sessions belonging exclusively to the other rep/territory appear.
cases.expectedResult: Only sessions scoped to the logged-in field user (server-scoped fetchTrainingSessions) are listed. The other rep's territory-only sessions are not visible, and the user cannot check in/complete a session that is not theirs.

cases.title: Session load failure shows an error state, not a blank screen
cases.preconditions: Logged in. CRM training endpoint returns an error or is unreachable on open (e.g. start the screen in airplane mode).
cases.steps:
1. Toggle airplane mode ON.
2. Open Training from the More tab (cold).
3. Observe the screen.
cases.expectedResult: An ErrorState banner with the failure message renders; the Hero metric strip and Refresh button remain usable. No crash and no infinite spinner. Tapping 'Refresh training' after reconnect recovers the list.

cases.title: Today 'Finish training work' next-action navigates to the Training screen
cases.preconditions: Logged in; >=1 training session is due so the next-action card surfaces 'Finish training work'. Online.
cases.steps:
1. From a cold start land on Today.
2. Locate the Start-here next-action card (or training-due action).
3. Tap it.
cases.expectedResult: The app navigates (router.push '/training') to the Training execution screen with the session list loaded. Back navigation returns to Today; the tab back-stack is intact.

cases.title: In-progress training entries survive backgrounding/foregrounding
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session; Details/Proof/Follow-up partially filled. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Fill attendees=6 and notes 'QA-E2E background test'; advance to Proof.
2. Press the simulator Home (send app to background) for ~30s.
3. Reopen the app.
4. Inspect the current step and entered values.
cases.expectedResult: On foreground the app returns to the Training screen with the same selected session, current step, attendee count, and notes preserved (in-memory state retained). No data loss and no forced re-check-in.

cases.title: Expired access token refreshes silently mid-session during completion
cases.preconditions: Logged in with a near-expiry access token; checked-in session ready to complete. Online.
cases.steps:
1. Leave the app idle on the Submit step until the access token expires (or force token expiry).
2. Tap 'Complete training'.
3. Observe the outcome.
cases.expectedResult: The session-provider refresh path obtains a new token (refreshPulseSession) and the completion succeeds with 'CRM saved' without forcing a re-login. If refresh fails, the user is signed out cleanly rather than silently dropping the submission.

cases.title: Denying camera permission surfaces guidance and does not crash
cases.preconditions: Logged in; checked-in session; on Step 3. Camera permission has not been granted.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Camera'.
2. When iOS prompts, tap Don't Allow.
3. Observe the proof status.
4. Tap 'Gallery' as a fallback.
cases.expectedResult: Proof status shows an error-tone message 'Camera access is required to capture training proof.' (via buildProofUploadStatusFromError). No crash. Gallery remains available as an alternative proof path, and proof notes can still satisfy the submit gate.

cases.title: VoiceOver labels, step pills, and tap targets are accessible
cases.preconditions: Logged in; Training screen with at least one session. VoiceOver enabled in Accessibility settings.
cases.steps:
1. Enable VoiceOver.
2. Swipe through the session cards.
3. Navigate the step pills and the Check in / Continue / Complete buttons.
4. Verify selected-session announcement and that 'Clear follow-up task' is labelled.
5. Increase Dynamic Type and re-check the layout.
cases.expectedResult: Each session card is announced as a button with the session title and a selected state; buttons expose accessibility labels (Check in, Continue, Complete training, Clear follow-up task). Tap targets are at least ~44pt. Larger Dynamic Type reflows text without clipping critical controls.

cases.title: Training screen adapts to iPad width and rotation
cases.preconditions: Logged in. Running on an iPad simulator (or iPhone with rotation).
cases.steps:
1. Open Training on an iPad simulator in portrait.
2. Confirm the content column is capped/centred.
3. Rotate to landscape.
4. Re-check the metric strip, step pills, and the Complete-session card.
cases.expectedResult: Content width is capped and centred on iPad (shared Screen width hook). On rotation the metric strip, step pills, and form fields reflow without overlap or clipping. Note: pixel/device verification of safe-area insets in landscape is still flagged partial in the PRD (FR-MOB-009).

cases.title: Session list degrades gracefully on slow/flaky signal
cases.preconditions: Logged in. Network conditioner set to a slow/lossy profile (e.g. Edge / 100% loss spikes).
cases.steps:
1. Apply a slow network profile in the simulator (Network Link Conditioner).
2. Open Training.
3. Observe loading behaviour and any partial render.
cases.expectedResult: LoadingState persists during the slow fetch; on timeout/failure an ErrorState is shown with Refresh available rather than a blank or frozen screen. A successful slow load eventually populates the list. The app remains responsive (tabs still switchable).

cases.title: Training is reachable within 2 taps via More and back-stack is preserved
cases.preconditions: Logged in; on Today.
cases.steps:
1. Tap More.
2. Tap Training.
3. Select a session and advance to Step 3.
4. Tap the Today tab, then return to Training via More.
5. Use the system back gesture/header back.
cases.expectedResult: Training is reached within 2 taps (More -> Training). Switching tabs and returning preserves the Training screen state (selected session/step). Back navigation returns to the prior surface without losing the tab back-stack or crashing.

cases.title: Route seeds with accounts sorted by ascending lastEngagementAt
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a field TM with >=8 territory accounts that have varied lastEngagementAt dates; clean app launch with no saved route selection.
cases.steps: 1. Launch the app on the iOS simulator and sign in. 2. Tap the Route tab. 3. Observe the auto-seeded route list (first 8 stops). 4. On each stop card read the 'Last touch' chip date.
cases.expectedResult: The route is pre-populated with up to 8 stops ordered by oldest last engagement first; the 'Last touch' chip dates ascend (oldest at top). The hero 'Stops' metric equals the number of seeded stops.

cases.title: Empty-state shows when no accounts load
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM whose territory currently has zero accounts (or filtered to none).
cases.steps: 1. Sign in as the zero-account rep. 2. Tap the Route tab. 3. Wait for the loading spinner to clear.
cases.expectedResult: After 'Building route plan...' clears, the EmptyState 'No stops on the route yet' with the 'Tap Add stops to build a route, or Load suggested...' detail is shown; the Stops metric reads 0; no crash.

cases.title: Add, reorder, set dwell, and remove a stop persist across tab switch
cases.preconditions: Route tab open with a seeded route of >=3 stops.
cases.steps: 1. Tap 'Add stops', pick QA-E2E-ACCT-ADD, tap close. 2. On a stop tap the up/down chevrons to reorder it. 3. Tap the 'Dwell: 30 min' chip twice to cycle the dwell. 4. Tap the x (remove) on another stop. 5. Switch to the Map tab and back to Route.
cases.expectedResult: The added stop appears; reorder changes the numbered position; dwell cycles by 15-min steps and wraps at the max back to the min; removed stop disappears and its dwell entry is dropped; the edited selection is preserved when returning from Map (shared selection store).

cases.title: Optimize order and per-stop arrival ETA computed for located stops
cases.preconditions: Route has >=2 stops that carry latitude/longitude (located) plus at least one stop without coordinates.
cases.steps: 1. Note the current straight-line mileage banner. 2. Tap 'Optimize order'. 3. Observe the reordered list and the plan message. 4. Adjust the 'Start' time with +/- and 'Now'. 5. Read the per-stop 'Arrive ~HH:MM' labels and the '-> finish ~HH:MM' estimate.
cases.expectedResult: Located stops are reordered nearest-neighbour (plan message states the count), unlocated stops sink to the end; total straight-line miles and per-stop leg miles recompute; arrival times derive from start time + dwell + travel and are suppressed after the first unlocated leg; finish estimate notes 'excludes unlocated stops' when not all stops are located.

cases.title: Optimize disabled with fewer than 2 located stops
cases.preconditions: Route contains 0 or 1 stops that have coordinates.
cases.steps: 1. Build a route with one located stop and any number of unlocated stops. 2. Observe the 'Optimize order' button. 3. Attempt to tap it.
cases.expectedResult: The 'Optimize order' button is disabled (locatedStopCount < 2); if forced, the plan message 'Add at least 2 located stops to optimize the order.' is shown and the order is unchanged.

cases.title: Load suggested orders stops from the server route plan
cases.preconditions: Signed in; the territory map workspace returns routePlans covering some loaded accounts.
cases.steps: 1. On the Route tab tap 'Load suggested'. 2. Wait for the 'Loading...' label to clear. 3. Read the plan message and the new stop order.
cases.expectedResult: Stops reorder into the server's suggested sequence; plan message reports the number loaded and how many suggested stops aren't in loaded accounts; if no plan covers loaded accounts the message 'No server route plan covers your loaded accounts yet...' shows and the route is unchanged.

cases.title: Save a named route, reload it, and handle stops not in loaded accounts
cases.preconditions: Route tab with a built route of >=2 stops and known dwell/start values.
cases.steps: 1. Tap 'Save / load', enter name QA-E2E-ROUTE-MON, save. 2. Clear/rebuild the route differently. 3. Reopen the sheet and tap the saved QA-E2E-ROUTE-MON to load it. 4. Re-save under the same name to confirm replace-not-duplicate.
cases.expectedResult: Route persists with stops, dwell map, and start time; loading restores them; if some saved stop ids are not in loaded accounts the message reports how many were dropped; re-saving the same name updates rather than creating a duplicate; a device-storage failure surfaces the 'kept for this session only' message.

cases.feature: Colour-coded map pins by account status
cases.title: Map renders status-coloured pins matching the agreed scheme
cases.preconditions: Signed in with accounts spanning active, inactive, onboarding, members-list, consignment-overdue, and prospect statuses; consignment sites loaded.
cases.steps: 1. Tap the Map tab. 2. Wait for accounts to load (footer shows 'N shown'). 3. Compare each marker colour against the legend chips at the bottom. 4. Tap a marker.
cases.expectedResult: Each pin colour matches ACCOUNT_MAP_STATUS_META for its derived status (consignment-overdue derived from per-site signals); footer count equals visible markers; tapping a marker pushes /account/[id].

cases.title: State-centroid pins block navigation; city-level pins navigate with approximate flag
cases.preconditions: Map workspace returns accounts with geoPrecision state_fallback and city_state.
cases.steps: 1. Open the Map tab and read the top 'Approximate positions...' banner. 2. Long-press a state_fallback (state-only) pin to open the marker action sheet. 3. Observe the Navigate option. 4. Long-press a city_state pin and tap Navigate.
cases.expectedResult: The approximate-position banner is always visible; for a state-level pin the Navigate action is disabled/absent (canNavigateWithPrecision false); for a city-level pin Navigate is enabled and opens the Navigate chooser with the approximate-location warning; accessibility label includes the precision label.

cases.title: Toggling status filters shows/hides matching pins (multi-select)
cases.preconditions: Map tab open with pins of at least three different statuses.
cases.steps: 1. Tap a status chip (e.g. 'Prospect') to toggle it off. 2. Confirm those pins disappear and footer count drops. 3. Toggle off a second status. 4. Toggle both back on.
cases.expectedResult: Each chip independently filters its status; multiple can be off at once; footer 'N shown' updates; chip selected state and accessibility label ('<status> filter on/off') reflect the toggle; re-enabling restores the pins.

cases.title: Add a stop to the route from a map marker long-press
cases.preconditions: Map tab open; an account not currently on the route.
cases.steps: 1. Long-press a pin to open the marker action sheet. 2. Tap 'Add to route'. 3. Confirm the pin border thickens (on-route) and footer shows 'N on route'. 4. Switch to the Route tab.
cases.expectedResult: The account is added to the shared route selection; the marker shows the on-route border; the Route tab lists the new stop (no ghost/duplicate), confirming both tabs share the selection store.

cases.title: Tapping Check in creates and checks into a CRM visit record immediately
cases.preconditions: Signed in with a valid token; online; a stop on the route; location permission granted.
cases.steps: 1. On a route stop card tap 'Check in'. 2. Observe the active visit card appears with 'Checked in' and timestamp. 3. Watch the CRM status pill transition. 4. In the CRM web confirm a site-visit/training session was created for the account.
cases.expectedResult: An active visit card appears immediately on tap with haptic feedback; CRM status pill goes pending -> 'CRM checked in'; a session record is created server-side and checked in; the visit shows 'GPS captured' once location resolves.

cases.title: Check in blocked when not signed in
cases.preconditions: Session cleared / signed out but Route screen reachable (e.g. token wiped).
cases.steps: 1. With no auth identity, tap 'Check in' on a stop.
cases.expectedResult: No visit is created; the message 'Sign in before starting a route visit so CRM can assign the trainer correctly.' is shown; no CRM call is made.

cases.title: GPS latitude/longitude stored on visit when permission granted
cases.preconditions: iOS simulator with a custom location set (Features > Location > Custom Location); location permission not yet decided.
cases.steps: 1. Tap 'Check in' on a stop. 2. When iOS prompts for location, tap 'Allow While Using App'. 3. Observe the visit card pill. 4. Complete the visit and inspect the completion summary.
cases.expectedResult: Permission prompt appears; on allow, the visit pill shows 'GPS captured'; rounded lat/long are stored on the visit and echoed in the checkout completion summary ('GPS captured near ...').

cases.title: Permission denied still allows a timed-only visit to complete
cases.preconditions: Location permission previously denied for the app (Settings > Privacy > Location > Pulse > Never).
cases.steps: 1. Tap 'Check in' on a stop. 2. Observe no GPS is captured. 3. Read the location error banner. 4. Enter checkout notes and tap 'Complete visit'.
cases.expectedResult: Visit pill shows 'Timed only'; the banner 'Location permission was not granted. The visit can still be timed, but GPS evidence is missing.' appears; check-in is NOT blocked; checkout completes and the summary reads 'Timed visit only; GPS was not captured.'

cases.title: Location lookup error does not block the visit
cases.preconditions: Permission granted but simulator location set to 'None' (no fix) so getCurrentPositionAsync fails or hangs.
cases.steps: 1. Set Simulator location to None. 2. Tap 'Check in' on a stop. 3. Observe the visit state and any error banner.
cases.expectedResult: The visit still starts and is checked in to CRM; a location error banner ('Unable to capture current location.') appears; the visit remains 'Timed only' and is completable.

cases.title: Complete visit blocked until checkout notes entered
cases.preconditions: An active checked-in visit on the Route screen with an empty notes field.
cases.steps: 1. With the notes field empty, observe the 'Complete visit' button. 2. Type only spaces, observe the button. 3. Type real notes 'QA-E2E checkout note' and tap 'Complete visit'.
cases.expectedResult: 'Complete visit' is disabled while notes are empty or whitespace-only; it enables only with non-blank notes; tapping with notes completes the visit.

cases.title: Cannot start a new check-in while a visit is open
cases.preconditions: One active visit checked-in and not yet completed.
cases.steps: 1. With an active visit open, look at every other stop card's 'Check in' button. 2. Attempt to tap 'Check in' on a different stop.
cases.expectedResult: All stop cards are disabled (RouteStopCard disabled while activeVisit present); no second visit can be started until the current one is checked out, enforcing 'can't check in anywhere else until checkout completes'.

cases.title: Completed visit appears in the Completed today list
cases.preconditions: Online; a checked-in visit with notes ready to complete.
cases.steps: 1. Enter checkout notes and tap 'Complete visit'. 2. Wait for 'Saving visit...' to clear. 3. Scroll to the 'Completed today' section. 4. Read the entry.
cases.expectedResult: On success the 'Visit saved / CRM saved' success notice shows with a success haptic; the visit moves to 'Completed today' with the account name, check-in→check-out timestamps, and notes; the hero 'Done' metric increments; the stop card now shows 'Complete' and is disabled.

cases.title: Completed visit saved as a retryable draft when CRM is unreachable, then syncs on reconnect
cases.preconditions: A visit is checked in; device about to lose connectivity; Sync Status screen reachable from More.
cases.steps: 1. Toggle Airplane Mode on in iOS Settings. 2. Enter checkout notes and tap 'Complete visit'. 3. Read the result message. 4. Toggle Airplane Mode off. 5. Go to More > Sync Status and tap retry.
cases.expectedResult: Completion fails the live call but saves a route_visit draft ('Draft on phone. Retry from Sync Status when CRM is reachable.'); the visit still moves to Completed today; on reconnect retry from Sync Status replays create→check-in→complete and marks the draft synced.

cases.title: Checked-in visit is restored after force-quit / cold start
cases.preconditions: A visit is checked in (draft persisted to SecureStore) but not yet completed.
cases.steps: 1. Check in at a stop (do not complete). 2. Force-quit the app from the simulator app switcher. 3. Relaunch the app and open the Route tab.
cases.expectedResult: The active visit is restored from the durable draft with the message 'Checked-in visit restored from this phone. Add checkout notes and complete it here.'; prior notes (if any) repopulate; CRM status reflects checked_in or local_only; the visit can be completed.

cases.title: Check-in/complete with an expired token saves draft and prompts re-sign-in
cases.preconditions: A checked-in visit; access token forced to expire (401/403 from CRM).
cases.steps: 1. Let the session token expire (or invalidate it server-side). 2. Enter notes and tap 'Complete visit'. 3. Read the message. 4. Re-sign-in and retry from Sync Status.
cases.expectedResult: On 401/403 the visit is saved as a draft with 'Draft on phone. Sign in again, then retry from Sync Status.'; notes are preserved; after re-auth the Sync Status retry completes the visit. (If silent refresh is implemented, the call instead succeeds transparently.)

cases.title: Card-like number in checkout notes is rejected by CRM with a payment-card message
cases.preconditions: A checked-in visit; online with a valid token.
cases.steps: 1. In the checkout notes field type 'Customer card on file QA-E2E 4111111111111111 exp'. 2. Tap 'Complete visit'. 3. Read the resulting error/draft message.
cases.expectedResult: The completion is rejected and surfaced with a payment-card message ('appears to contain payment card data, which cannot be stored in Pulse...'); the visit is not completed; notes remain editable so the tester can remove the number. NOTE: the PCI guard (apps/api/src/utils/pci.ts) is NOT currently wired into the training-session complete handler (no assertNoPaymentCard call in apps/api/src/modules/training/service.ts), so this case is expected to FAIL today — a card number would be stored. File as a defect.
cases.testData: QA-E2E never use a real PAN; use test value 4111111111111111

cases.title: Navigate chooser opens Apple/Google/Waze and remembers last provider
cases.preconditions: A route stop with coordinates; at least one nav app installed (Apple Maps always present on iOS).
cases.steps: 1. On a located stop card tap 'Navigate'. 2. In the chooser tap 'Google Maps'. 3. Confirm the external app (or web fallback) opens with directions. 4. Return to Pulse, tap 'Navigate' again on any stop. 5. Observe provider order.
cases.expectedResult: The chooser lists Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze; selecting one opens that provider's deep link (https fallback if app/scheme unavailable) for the stop coordinate in driving mode; the chosen provider floats to the top and is labelled 'Last used' on the next open. In-app turn-by-turn is intentionally not provided.

cases.title: Navigate action absent for a stop without coordinates
cases.preconditions: Route contains a stop with no latitude/longitude.
cases.steps: 1. Locate an unlocated stop card. 2. Inspect the card footer actions.
cases.expectedResult: The 'Navigate' button is not rendered for the unlocated stop (canNavigate false); only 'View' and 'Check in' are shown; no nav chooser can be triggered for it.

cases.title: Chooser ignores a second tap mid-launch and dismisses on backdrop
cases.preconditions: Navigate chooser open for a located stop.
cases.steps: 1. Tap 'Navigate' to open the chooser. 2. Rapidly double-tap a provider row. 3. Reopen the chooser and tap the dim backdrop (not a provider).
cases.expectedResult: Only one launch occurs on rapid double-tap (launchingRef guard); tapping the backdrop dismisses the sheet without launching any app; the inner sheet area does not dismiss when tapped.

cases.feature: Account detail deep-link from a route stop
cases.title: View opens the account detail route and back-stack returns to Route
cases.preconditions: Route tab with at least one stop.
cases.steps: 1. On a stop card tap 'View'. 2. Confirm the account detail screen (/account/[id]) loads. 3. Tap the back navigation. 4. Confirm return to the Route tab with the route intact.
cases.expectedResult: The account detail route pushes onto the stack with the correct account; back returns to the Route tab; the route selection, active visit, and Completed-today list are preserved.

cases.title: Sections degrade independently under throttled network
cases.preconditions: Network Link Conditioner set to a high-latency/low-bandwidth profile.
cases.steps: 1. Enable a poor-network profile on the simulator host. 2. Open the Route tab. 3. Observe the loading state and the server-suggested-route load. 4. Pull down to refresh via 'Refresh accounts'.
cases.expectedResult: The route list shows a loading state then renders; if the suggested-route fetch is slow/fails it surfaces 'Could not load the server route plan. Build or optimize the route manually.' without blocking the manual builder; the rest of the screen (locally seeded stops) stays usable (FR-MOB-004 degrade-independently).

cases.title: Active visit survives app backgrounding and foregrounding
cases.preconditions: A visit checked in with notes partially typed.
cases.steps: 1. Check in at a stop and type partial notes. 2. Press the simulator Home (swipe up) to background the app for ~30s. 3. Reopen the app and return to the Route tab.
cases.expectedResult: The active visit card and entered notes are retained; check-in timestamp unchanged; the visit can still be completed; no duplicate visit or lost draft.

cases.title: VoiceOver labels, tap targets, and dynamic type on route stop controls
cases.preconditions: iOS Simulator with VoiceOver on and Larger Text set near max in Accessibility settings.
cases.steps: 1. Enable VoiceOver. 2. Swipe through a route stop card's controls. 3. Increase Dynamic Type to a large size and review the stop cards. 4. Inspect the dwell chip, move up/down, remove, and the status dot.
cases.expectedResult: Each control announces a meaningful label (e.g. 'Move <account> up', 'Remove <account> from route', 'Dwell N minutes at <account>, tap to change', 'Check in at <account>', 'Map status: <label>'); icon buttons meet ~40-44pt tap targets with hitSlop; text reflows without truncation under large Dynamic Type.

cases.title: Type a transcript, pick General context, and sync a voice note to CRM
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM/field rep against https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com; device online; on the Voice Notes tab.
cases.steps:
1. Tap the Voice Notes tab.
2. In Title, type 'QA-E2E-General-Note'.

cases.title: Sync a voice note in airplane mode then reconnect
cases.preconditions: Signed in; Voice Notes tab open. A note (transcript) ready to send.
cases.steps:
1. Open Settings and toggle Airplane Mode ON (or disable Wi-Fi in the simulator's network link conditioner).
2. Return to the app, type transcript 'QA-E2E offline note', keep 'General'.
3. Tap 'Sync for office review'.
4. Observe the result.
5. Toggle Airplane Mode OFF and retry sync.
cases.expectedResult: While offline the sync fails with a clear error ('Could not sync voice note to CRM.'); the typed transcript is NOT lost. After reconnecting and tapping Sync again, the note posts and the 'Synced to CRM' card appears. NOTE: the standalone Voice Notes capture sends directly and does not auto-queue to the on-device draft queue, so the user must manually retry — verify the field text is preserved across the failed attempt.

cases.title: Incoming call / backgrounding interrupts an active recording
cases.preconditions: Microphone granted; Voice Notes tab open; recording in progress.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Record' and start speaking.
2. Trigger an interruption: simulate an incoming phone call (Hardware menu) or background the app (swipe up to Home) for ~10s.
3. Return to the app.
4. Tap 'Stop' if still showing recording, then attempt to Sync.
cases.expectedResult: App does not crash on interruption. Recording either stops gracefully or resumes; on Stop the captured audio file is still retrievable (uri available) and sync works, OR a clear error ('Recording stopped, but the audio file was not available.') is shown if the OS dropped the buffer. No silent corruption.

cases.title: KNOWN GAP — logging a call disposition while offline fails without an offline queue

cases.title: Account detail loads partially when one supporting endpoint fails on poor signal

cases.title: Cold-start deep link opens a lead detail and the back stack returns to the inbox

cases.expectedResult: The app cold-starts and opens the lead detail for that id (header shows the company name). Back navigation lands on a valid screen (Lead inbox/Today) without a blank stack or crash.

cases.title: KNOWN GAP — lists and detail screens do not support pull-to-refresh
cases.preconditions: On the Lead inbox / Accounts list, or a lead/account detail.
cases.steps:

cases.title: Lead 'Voice note' action opens the recorder pre-scoped to the lead

cases.title: Voice note from a lead handles denied microphone permission gracefully

cases.title: Disposition/stage panels survive app backgrounding and device rotation

cases.title: Lead/account detail shows a loading indicator then content, with no flash of empty

3. While it is still 'Sending', force-quit Pulse from the app switcher.

cases.expectedResult: After relaunch the draft is no longer stuck on 'Sending' — it has been reset to 'Saved on phone' (retryable). On reload, any 'syncing' status is normalized back to pending so the tester can retry again.

cases.title: When durable phone storage cannot be confirmed, drafts fall back to in-memory with a visible warning
cases.preconditions: A build/run where SecureStore is unavailable (e.g. run as web target where localStorage is blocked, or simulate a SecureStore failure). Signed in.
cases.steps:
1. Launch Pulse in the condition where the secure draft store cannot be opened.
2. Save an offline draft (route/ROSE/training).
3. Open Sync Status and read the storage banner.
cases.expectedResult: A 'Draft storage warning' card appears stating drafts are kept for this session only, this device could not confirm durable phone storage, and advising not to sign out until CRM saves the work. The draft still appears in the list (in-memory) rather than silently vanishing.

cases.feature: No media bytes in offline drafts
cases.title: ROSE audit with evidence photos saves offline as metadata only — no binary bytes
cases.preconditions: On the Consignment / ROSE audit flow with at least one site. Camera permission granted. Airplane mode ON.
cases.steps:
1. Start a ROSE audit, enter actual counts for 1-2 lines.
2. Attach a general evidence photo and a discrepancy evidence photo from the camera.
3. Submit/Save the audit while offline.
4. Open Sync Status, open the ROSE draft card and read the evidence note.
cases.expectedResult: The draft saves successfully. The card states only photo metadata is kept and 'photo bytes are not stored offline' / 'offline drafts keep photo metadata only until CRM accepts the upload'. Evidence file names are redacted to generic names (e.g. rose-evidence-1.jpg). No base64/file-URI content is persisted.

cases.title: A draft payload that would carry a media URI / blob key is rejected by the sanitizer
cases.preconditions: Tester can drive a flow that attempts to attach an image preview URI into a savable draft field (e.g. an evidence note pasted with a file:// URI, or a flow that puts an image localUri in text).
cases.steps:
1. Offline, in a draft-producing flow, enter into a free-text note a value resembling a stored media reference, e.g. 'file:///var/mobile/IMG_QA-E2E.jpg' AND attempt to save a payload that includes a blocked key (uri/base64/blob/photo/image/attachment).
2. Tap Save.
cases.expectedResult: The save is blocked with a clear message: 'Media files are not stored in offline drafts yet. Save text evidence only...'. The draft is NOT persisted with any binary/URI content. Confirms the regex blocked-key guard in sanitizeDraft is active.

cases.title: Account/customer names are redacted from offline draft titles
cases.preconditions: Offline. A real account named e.g. 'QA-E2E-Acme Outfitters' is the subject of a route visit / order draft.
cases.steps:
1. Offline, create an order draft (or route visit) against account 'QA-E2E-Acme Outfitters'.
2. Save offline.
3. Open Sync Status and inspect the draft card title and the displayed account label.
cases.expectedResult: The draft title is a generic label (e.g. 'Order draft', 'Route visit draft', 'ROSE audit draft') and the stored accountName is redacted to a generic value ('Order account' / 'Field account' / 'Consignment site' / 'Training account'). The real customer name does not appear in the persisted draft title.

cases.title: Over-long notes are truncated so a draft cannot exceed the durable-storage size cap
cases.preconditions: Offline. In an order-draft or ROSE/training draft flow.
cases.steps:
1. Offline, paste a very long note (>1000 characters, e.g. 'QA-E2E-' repeated) into the draft notes field.
2. Save offline.
3. Open Sync Status and inspect the saved note on the draft card.
cases.expectedResult: The save succeeds; the persisted note is truncated to ~1000 chars (order/ROSE/training) and per-line notes to ~200 chars. A pathologically large draft that would exceed the 16KB per-draft cap surfaces a 'This offline draft is too large' guidance message rather than failing silently.

cases.title: Draft queue caps at 20 entries — oldest drop off
cases.preconditions: Offline. Signed in.
cases.steps:
1. Offline, create more than 20 offline drafts (e.g. repeatedly save quick route-visit drafts).
2. Open Sync Status and count the draft cards.
cases.expectedResult: The queue holds at most 20 drafts; the newest are kept and the oldest beyond the cap are dropped. The app does not crash or balloon storage. (Confirms the slice(0,20) cap.)

cases.title: Route/training drafts expire after 72h; ROSE/order drafts persist for 7 days
cases.preconditions: Ability to advance the device clock (Settings > General > Date & Time, disable Set Automatically) or seed drafts with backdated createdAt.
cases.steps:
1. Create one route_visit draft and one order_draft (or ROSE) draft offline.
2. Advance the simulator clock forward by ~80 hours.
3. Relaunch Pulse and open Sync Status.
cases.expectedResult: The route_visit (and training) draft has expired and no longer appears (72h window). The order_draft / ROSE draft is still present (7-day window). Confirms the differentiated isDraftFresh expiry policy.

cases.title: A retry that the server rejects with 409 moves the draft to 'Needs review' with conflict guidance
cases.preconditions: An offline draft whose server-side record has since changed/completed (e.g. the same ROSE audit was completed in CRM web), so retry returns 409/412/423. Signed in, online.
cases.steps:
1. Bring the device online.
2. Open Sync Status, tap Retry on the conflicting draft.
3. Read the resulting pill and guidance card.
cases.expectedResult: Draft transitions to the 'Needs review' canonical state (conflict tone). A 'Review before discarding' card appears warning CRM may already have a newer/completed version, and to compare phone copy with CRM/RD before retrying. The per-draft retry button is disabled ('Review before retry') — conflicts are not auto-retryable.

cases.title: Draft status copy uses only the canonical six states
cases.preconditions: Sync Status populated with drafts in varied states (saved-on-phone, sending, synced, failed/retryable, conflict, auth-expired).
cases.steps:
1. Drive drafts into each state (offline save; mid-retry; successful sync; server 500 -> retryable; 409 -> needs review; 401 -> sign in again).
2. Open Sync Status and read every status pill and helper line.
cases.expectedResult: All field-facing labels map to the canonical set: 'Saved on phone', 'Sending', 'CRM saved', 'Ready to retry'/'Needs retry', 'Sign in again', 'Needs review'. No legacy vocabulary (e.g. 'queued', 'pending sync', 'error') appears in field-facing copy.

cases.title: Retry rejected with 401/403 moves the draft to 'Sign in again' and keeps it on the phone
cases.preconditions: An offline draft exists and the session token is expired/invalid (let it sit past expiry, or force a token that the API rejects with 401).
cases.steps:
1. With an expired session, open Sync Status.
2. Tap Retry on a draft.
3. Read the pill, the SignInGuidance card, and the retry button label.
4. Tap 'Refresh session' (or sign in again), then retry.
cases.expectedResult: The draft becomes 'Sign in again' (not lost). A 'Sign in again before retrying' card appears; the retry button reads 'Sign in to retry' and is disabled until re-auth. After a successful session refresh/sign-in, retrying syncs the draft. The phone copy is preserved throughout.

cases.title: A repeatedly-failing draft stops auto-offering retry after 3 attempts and routes to review
cases.preconditions: An offline draft that consistently fails server-side with a retryable (5xx) error.
cases.steps:
1. Online but with the endpoint returning 5xx (or backend mock). Open Sync Status.
2. Tap Retry on the draft three times, letting each fail.
3. After the 3rd failure, read the draft's retry state.
cases.expectedResult: After the retry count reaches 3, the draft is no longer treated as retryable (button shows 'Review before retry' / disabled) and is surfaced for manual review rather than looping. The phone copy remains for the tester to review.

cases.title: Today section status shows partial/failed per section on a flaky connection without blanking the workspace
cases.preconditions: Signed in. Network Link Conditioner set to a lossy/slow profile so some Today endpoints fail while others succeed.
cases.steps:
1. Apply a lossy network profile (e.g. 'Very Bad Network').
2. Open the Today tab and pull down to refresh.
3. Read the section status strip (each section shows ready / a count / 'failed').
cases.expectedResult: Failed sections show a 'failed' state while other sections still render their data (degrade independently). The overall pill reads 'partial' when only some sections failed. A single failing endpoint never blanks the whole Today workspace.

cases.title: Today renders gracefully with all live sections failed when fully offline
cases.preconditions: Signed in once online (so cache exists). Airplane mode ON.
cases.steps:
1. Toggle Airplane Mode ON.
2. Open / pull-to-refresh the Today tab.
3. Observe the section status strip and the rest of the screen.
cases.expectedResult: All live sections report 'failed' but the screen does not crash or go blank — the metric strip, navigation, and the offline draft bell remain usable. No unhandled error screen.

cases.title: Header bell badge reflects the count of phone-saved (unsynced) drafts on every surface
cases.preconditions: Signed in. Start with zero unsynced drafts.
cases.steps:
1. Note the header bell shows no draft badge.
2. Offline, save 2 drafts.
3. Check the bell badge on Today, then navigate to Route, Consignment, and More and check the bell on each.
4. Sync/discard one draft and recheck the badge.
cases.expectedResult: The bell appears in the header on every screen and its badge equals the unsynced draft count (2). The count is consistent across all surfaces and decrements to 1 after one draft is synced/removed. Tapping the bell opens the notifications/sync surface.

cases.title: Backgrounding and foregrounding the app during an in-flight retry does not lose or duplicate the draft
cases.preconditions: Online (normal speed). One retryable draft in Sync Status.
cases.steps:
1. Open Sync Status, tap Retry so the draft shows 'Sending'.
2. Immediately press the simulator Home button to background the app for ~10s.
3. Reopen Pulse and return to Sync Status.
cases.expectedResult: The draft ends in a coherent state — either 'CRM saved' (if the request completed) or back to a retryable 'Saved on phone'/'Ready to retry'. It is never duplicated and never permanently stuck on 'Sending'.

cases.title: Retry controls are disabled when there is no active session
cases.preconditions: Drafts exist locally but the user is signed out (no auth).
cases.steps:
1. Sign out (or open Sync Status in a not-signed-in state where drafts remain).
2. Read the 'Connected session' pill and the retry buttons.
cases.expectedResult: The session pill reads 'not signed in'. The 'Retry ready updates' button reads 'Sign in to retry updates' and is disabled; per-draft retry is disabled. Drafts remain protected on the phone. No retry is attempted without a token.

cases.feature: PCI guard on synced free text
cases.title: A payment card number in an offline note is rejected by the API on sync with a payment-card message
cases.preconditions: Signed in, online. A draft-producing flow with a free-text note that syncs to the API (order note / ROSE note / training note / voice transcript).
cases.steps:
1. Create a draft (e.g. order draft) and enter into the note a Luhn-valid test PAN with a card prefix, e.g. 'QA-E2E pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242'. (Use a known test value, never a real card.)
2. Save offline, then open Sync Status and tap Retry to sync.
3. Read the resulting draft state and error message.
cases.expectedResult: The API rejects the write; the draft does NOT reach CRM. The surfaced error indicates the text 'appears to contain payment card data, which cannot be stored in Pulse. Remove the card number...'. The draft moves to a 'Needs review' state (validation), preserved on the phone for the tester to correct.

cases.title: A non-card numeric string in a note (order ID, phone, timestamp) syncs without a false PCI rejection
cases.preconditions: Signed in, online. Draft flow with a free-text note.
cases.steps:
1. Create a draft and enter a note containing a long non-card number, e.g. 'QA-E2E order 1700000000123, call 555 0142'.
2. Save offline, then sync from Sync Status.
cases.expectedResult: The note syncs successfully (CRM saved). The PCI guard does not falsely reject it because the digits lack a payment-card MII + Luhn structure. Confirms low false-positive behaviour.

cases.title: Asset library shows cached metadata offline and never stores file bytes
cases.preconditions: Signed in. Open the Assets surface once while online so the cache populates. Then go offline.
cases.steps:
1. Online: open the Assets list (More > Assets) so items load and cache.
2. Toggle Airplane Mode ON.
3. Force-quit and relaunch Pulse, reopen Assets.
4. Inspect the list and attempt to open/share an asset.
cases.expectedResult: Cached asset metadata (title, kind, status, version info) renders from the on-device cache even offline, capped at ~50 items. No asset binary/file bytes are stored on device (metadata only). Actions needing the network (create share link) surface an error rather than crashing.

cases.title: Asset cache refreshes from the server on reconnect and replaces stale metadata
cases.preconditions: Cached assets exist (from MOB-OFFLINE-024). An asset has been edited/removed server-side meanwhile.
cases.steps:
1. Toggle Airplane Mode OFF.
2. Open Assets and pull to refresh.
3. Compare the list to the server state.
cases.expectedResult: On a successful fetch the list updates to current server metadata and the cache is overwritten. If the fetch fails, the previously cached items are retained and an error message is shown (cache is a graceful fallback, not the source of truth).

cases.title: Pull-to-refresh while offline shows an error/empty state without losing existing data
cases.preconditions: Signed in with some loaded data. Airplane mode ON.
cases.steps:
1. On the Today tab (or Assets), pull down to refresh while offline.
2. Observe the refresh spinner, error/empty messaging, and existing content.
cases.expectedResult: The refresh completes (spinner ends), an offline/error state is shown for the failed sections, and previously loaded/cached content remains visible. The screen does not blank or crash.

cases.title: Sync Status shows a 'phone storage starting' state until the secure store hydrates
cases.preconditions: Cold start on a native build so the SecureStore hydration is observable.
cases.steps:
1. Cold-launch Pulse (force-quit first).
2. Immediately open Sync Status before hydration completes.
3. Read the storage state line and any 'Phone storage is starting' card.
cases.expectedResult: While storage is hydrating, Sync Status shows 'Phone storage loading' / 'Phone storage is starting' messaging and keeps new work on screen in memory. Once hydration completes it flips to 'ready' and the persisted drafts appear.

cases.title: Discarding a phone-only draft removes it without attempting a sync
cases.preconditions: An unsynced draft exists in Sync Status.
cases.steps:
1. Open Sync Status.
2. On an unsynced draft, tap 'Discard phone copy'.
3. Confirm and observe the list and the unsynced counter.
cases.expectedResult: The draft is removed from the list, the 'Saved only on this phone' counter decrements, and no network call/sync is attempted. Synced drafts instead offer 'Remove saved copy from phone'.

cases.title: VoiceOver reads draft status, and retry/discard controls have adequate labels and tap targets
cases.preconditions: Sync Status has at least one draft in a failed/retryable state. Enable VoiceOver (or Accessibility Inspector) on the simulator.
cases.steps:
1. Turn on VoiceOver.
2. Swipe through the Sync Status draft card: status pill, helper text, and the Retry / Discard buttons.
3. Increase Dynamic Type to a large setting and re-read the card.
cases.expectedResult: VoiceOver announces the draft title, its canonical status, and the action buttons with meaningful labels (e.g. 'Retry this update', 'Discard phone copy'). Buttons meet the ~44pt tap-target minimum and text reflows/remains readable at large Dynamic Type without truncating the status.

cases.title: Cold-starting directly into the Sync Status route shows persisted drafts after hydration
cases.preconditions: Persisted unsynced drafts exist. App force-quit.
cases.steps:
1. With the app force-quit, open the deep link / route to '/sync-status' (e.g. via `xcrun simctl openurl booted <scheme>://sync-status` or the in-app navigation on cold start).
2. Wait for the session and storage to hydrate.
cases.expectedResult: The Sync Status screen opens directly, the header back-stack is sensible (back returns to Today/tabs), and once storage hydrates the persisted drafts render with correct statuses. No crash on cold-start to the detail route.

cases.title: Sign in with valid Pulse field credentials reaches Today
cases.preconditions: App freshly launched, signed out, on the Login screen. Production base URL (https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com) selected. A valid Pulse account that has the 'mobile' scope exists.
cases.steps:
1. Launch the app on the iOS simulator.
2. On the Login screen, tap the Email field and enter QA-E2E-fieldrep@dynamicaqs.com.
3. Tap the Password field and enter the QA-E2E known-good password.
4. Tap 'Sign in'.
cases.expectedResult: Light haptic fires, button shows 'Signing in...', POST /api/v1/auth/login succeeds, and the app navigates (router.replace) to the Today home. The Login screen is removed from the back stack (back gesture does not return to Login).

cases.title: Sign in button stays disabled until both email and password entered
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen, both fields empty.
cases.steps:
1. Observe the 'Sign in' button with both fields empty.
2. Enter only an email (QA-E2E-fieldrep@dynamicaqs.com), leave password empty; observe the button.
3. Clear email, enter only a password; observe the button.
4. Enter both; observe the button.
cases.expectedResult: Sign in is disabled (greyed, non-tappable) for steps 1-3 (canSubmit requires trimmed email length > 0 AND password length > 0). It becomes enabled only in step 4. A whitespace-only email also keeps it disabled.

cases.title: Invalid password shows API error and stays on Login
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen, Production base URL selected, network online.
cases.steps:
1. Enter QA-E2E-fieldrep@dynamicaqs.com.
2. Enter a deliberately wrong password QA-E2E-wrongpass.
3. Tap 'Sign in'.
cases.expectedResult: POST /api/v1/auth/login returns 401; an ErrorState card appears below the form with the API's message (extractErrorMessage of detail/error/message). App remains on the Login screen, no navigation to Today, password field is not auto-cleared so the user can retry.

cases.title: Web-only Pulse account (no mobile scope) is rejected at login
cases.preconditions: A valid Pulse account whose session scopes do NOT include 'mobile' (e.g. a back-office/web-only user).
cases.steps:
1. On the Login screen enter QA-E2E-webonly@dynamicaqs.com and the correct password.
2. Tap 'Sign in'.
cases.expectedResult: Credentials authenticate but isMobileAuthAllowed returns false; signIn throws, the ErrorState shows 'This Pulse account is not enabled for the mobile field app.' No session is saved to secure store, and the app stays on Login.

cases.title: Unapproved API host is rejected at entry
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen, the API Environment card visible with the Base URL field.
cases.steps:
1. In the 'Base URL' field, clear it and type https://evil.example.com.
2. Enter valid credentials and tap 'Sign in'.
cases.expectedResult: normalizeApiBaseUrl throws 'This API host is not approved for Pulse Field.' before any request leaves the device; the error surfaces as the sign-in error message. Only pulse-crm.theclustox.com, localhost, and 127.0.0.1 are in the allowlist.

cases.title: Non-localhost HTTP base URL is rejected (HTTPS required)
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen, API Environment card visible.
cases.steps:
1. In the 'Base URL' field enter http://pulse-crm.theclustox.com (note: plain http).
2. Enter valid credentials and tap 'Sign in'.
cases.expectedResult: normalizeApiBaseUrl throws 'Pulse API connection must use HTTPS.' (protocol !== https and host is not local). No login request is sent. The same host over https:// is accepted.

cases.title: Local QA preset (http://127.0.0.1:4100) is permitted
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen. A local QA API is reachable at http://127.0.0.1:4100 (or expect a connection error if not running).
cases.steps:
1. In the API Environment card tap the 'Local QA' button.
2. Confirm the Base URL field now shows http://127.0.0.1:4100.
3. Enter QA-E2E credentials and tap 'Sign in'.
cases.expectedResult: URL validation accepts http for the localhost/127.0.0.1 host (the QA-only HTTP exception); the request is allowed to proceed to the local API. No 'must use HTTPS' or 'host not approved' error is raised for 127.0.0.1.

cases.title: Production preset button restores the approved production host
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen with a non-default value typed in the Base URL field.
cases.steps:
1. In the Base URL field type a garbage/custom value.
2. Tap the 'Production' button in the API Environment card.
3. Observe the Base URL field.
cases.expectedResult: Base URL field resets to https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com and any prior error message is cleared (setApiBaseUrl clears errorMessage). The field also supports select-on-focus for quick manual editing.

cases.title: Trailing slashes in the base URL are normalized before requests
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen.
cases.steps:
1. In the Base URL field enter https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com/// (trailing slashes).
2. Enter valid credentials and tap 'Sign in'.
cases.expectedResult: normalizeApiBaseUrl strips trailing slashes so the request path becomes https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com/api/v1/auth/login with no double slash; login succeeds.

cases.title: Signed-in session survives app kill and cold start
cases.preconditions: Signed in successfully (MOB-AUTH-001 passed), sitting on Today.
cases.steps:
1. Fully terminate the app from the iOS app switcher.
2. Relaunch the app from the home screen.
3. Observe the splash/loading spinner, then the landing screen.
cases.expectedResult: On launch the SessionGate shows the ActivityIndicator until isHydrated; loadStoredSession reads the chunked secure-store token, resolveStoredSession validates/refreshes it, and the user lands directly on Today WITHOUT re-entering credentials. Login is never shown.

cases.title: Sign out clears stored session and returns to Login
cases.preconditions: Signed in, on the Today tab where the 'Sign out' button is shown.
cases.steps:
1. On the Today tab, tap 'Sign out'.
2. Observe redirect.
3. Fully kill and relaunch the app.
cases.expectedResult: signOut clears auth state and calls clearStoredSession (all secure-store chunks + manifest deleted). SessionGate redirects to /auth/login immediately. After kill+relaunch the app starts on Login (no auto-resume), proving the token was wiped.

cases.title: Access token nearing expiry is silently refreshed on resume
cases.preconditions: Signed in. A stored session whose accessTokenExpiresAt is within 6 minutes of now (use a short-TTL QA token, or background the app past the refresh window).
cases.steps:
1. With a near-expiry access token, background the app for a few minutes, then foreground it (or trigger a cold start).
2. Observe network calls and that the user stays signed in.
3. Wait ~5 minutes with the app open to let the interval refresh fire.
cases.expectedResult: resolveStoredSession sees shouldRefreshAccessToken true (within PROACTIVE_REFRESH_WINDOW_MS) and calls POST /api/v1/auth/refresh; the new AuthBundle is saved to secure store. The 5-minute interval timer (setInterval in session-provider) also refreshes while the app stays open. The user is never bounced to Login.

cases.title: Fully expired refresh token forces re-login with clear message
cases.preconditions: Signed in, then the stored refresh token is revoked/expired server-side so /api/v1/auth/refresh returns 401/403.
cases.steps:
1. Revoke the QA session server-side (or use an expired refresh token).
2. Cold-start the app (or wait for the next refresh tick).
cases.expectedResult: fetch/me and refresh both fail; isSessionAuthFailure (401/403) is true, so resolveStoredSession returns auth=null, sets errorMessage 'Saved sign-in expired. Please sign in again.', and clears the stored session. SessionGate redirects to Login and the message is shown.

cases.feature: Session resilience on transient network error
cases.title: Refresh network failure (not auth) keeps user signed in with retry hint
cases.preconditions: Signed in with a still-valid (not 401) stored session. Network will be made unreachable so refresh throws a network error rather than 401/403.
cases.steps:
1. Enable Airplane Mode in iOS Settings.
2. Cold-start the app (or wait for the refresh interval).
3. Observe the landing screen.
cases.expectedResult: Both /me and /refresh throw a non-auth (network) error; isSessionAuthFailure is false, so the user is NOT logged out — stored auth (still mobile-allowed) is kept and the message 'Could not refresh the saved sign-in. Some CRM data may need a retry when the connection is stable.' is set. The user remains on Today; the stored session is not cleared.

cases.title: Re-enabling network after offline restores live data and refresh
cases.preconditions: Continuation of MOB-AUTH-014 — app open, in the offline-degraded state with the retry hint.
cases.steps:
1. With the app still in foreground, turn Airplane Mode OFF in iOS Settings.
2. Pull down to refresh on the Today tab.
3. Wait up to ~5 minutes for the background refresh interval.
cases.expectedResult: Once connectivity returns, the next /me or /refresh succeeds; session is re-validated and re-saved to secure store. Today sections that previously failed now load. No re-login is required and the retry hint clears.

cases.title: Every governed API call carries Bearer token and JSON headers
cases.preconditions: Signed in. A proxy/network inspector is attached to the simulator to read outbound requests.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate across Today, Leads, Accounts, Consignment, Training tabs to trigger fetches.
2. Inspect the outbound request headers in the proxy.
cases.expectedResult: requestJson sends Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and Accept: application/json on every authenticated GET, and adds Content-Type: application/json only when a body is present. No token appears in the URL/query string. All calls go to https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com.

cases.feature: Governed contract writes (no parallel data paths)
cases.title: A field write goes through the shared @pulse/contracts API path
cases.preconditions: Signed in. Network inspector attached. A lead exists in the field rep's book.
cases.steps:
1. Open a lead detail and perform a CRM write (e.g. log initial contact / transition stage).
2. Inspect the outbound request path and method.
cases.expectedResult: The write hits a governed /api/v1/... contract endpoint (e.g. POST /api/v1/leads/{id}/log-initial-contact or /stage-transition) identical to the web platform's path — no mobile-only endpoint or invented data model. Response is the same typed contract shape (LeadDetail).

cases.title: Field rep cannot read another rep's out-of-book records
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TM (field rep) whose book excludes a known record owned by another TM.
cases.steps:
1. While signed in as QA-E2E-fieldrep, attempt to open an account/lead that belongs to a different TM (e.g. via a deep link or stale list entry).
2. Observe the result.
cases.expectedResult: The server scopes the governed endpoint to the actor's book and returns 403/404 (PulseApiError); the screen shows an error/empty state, not the other rep's data. The mobile client does not bypass RBAC by hitting an alternate path.

cases.title: Field rep does not see the Director overview rollup
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a plain TM field rep (not RD/exec/admin).
cases.steps:
1. Open the 'More' tab and scan the menu.
2. Attempt to deep-link to /rd-dashboard.
cases.expectedResult: The role-gated 'Director overview' entry is not offered to a TM; if the RD-scoped reporting endpoints (/reports/dashboard/leads, /training) are called without authorization the server returns 403 and no cross-TM rollup is shown (TM cannot see other TMs' data).

cases.title: Card number typed into a voice-note transcript is rejected by the API
cases.preconditions: Signed in. On the Voice Notes tab with a free-text 'Transcript or quick note' field.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Voice Notes tab.
2. In the 'Transcript or quick note' field type: QA-E2E customer wants to pay with card 4111 1111 1111 1111.
3. Choose a CRM context and tap to sync/save the note.
cases.expectedResult: POST /api/v1/mobile/voice-notes is rejected by the server PCI guard (containsLikelyPaymentCardNumber: Luhn-valid, MII 2-6, 13-19 digits). The app surfaces a PulseApiError whose message contains 'appears to contain payment card data, which cannot be stored in Pulse.' The note is NOT persisted. (Never use a real PAN — 4111111111111111 is the public test number.)

cases.title: Card number split with separators/hidden chars is still rejected
cases.preconditions: Signed in, on a free-text capture field (voice-note transcript or a lead note).
cases.steps:
1. In the transcript field type a PAN with dashes: QA-E2E pay 4111-1111-1111-1111.
2. Save/sync.
3. Repeat with a non-card numeric string (e.g. order id QA-E2E-20250601123456) and save.
cases.expectedResult: Step 1-2: the API still rejects it with the payment-card-data message (the guard normalizes separators and invisible chars before Luhn matching). Step 3: the plain timestamp/order id (no MII+Luhn match) is accepted and saved normally — confirming low false positives.

cases.title: Cold-start deep link to a detail route while signed out lands on Login
cases.preconditions: Signed out (no stored session). A deep link to a protected detail route is available (e.g. /account/<id> or /lead/<id>).

cases.expectedResult: SessionGate sees auth=null and the route is not in the auth group, so it Redirects to /auth/login. The protected detail screen is never rendered without a session.

cases.title: Signed-in deep link straight to detail route renders it
cases.preconditions: Signed in with a valid stored session (mobile scope).
cases.steps:

2. Observe rendering and the back stack.
cases.expectedResult: Because auth is present and the route is not the auth group, SessionGate renders the Stack and the account detail loads directly. If a signed-in user opens /auth/login, SessionGate redirects them to '/' (cannot return to Login while authenticated).

cases.title: Corrupted or partial stored token is discarded, not crashed on
cases.preconditions: Signed in (a chunked session exists in secure store). Ability to corrupt one chunk or the chunk manifest (QA hook / debug).
cases.steps:

2. Cold-start the app.
cases.expectedResult: readSessionValue detects the invalid count / missing chunk, calls deleteSessionValue to wipe the partial blob, and returns null. loadStoredSession also clears on JSON parse failure or failed schema check (isStoredAuthBundle). The app does not crash; it lands on Login asking for fresh credentials.

cases.title: Base URL field uses URL keyboard, no autocorrect/autocapitalize
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen, API Environment card visible.
cases.steps:

2. Observe the keyboard type and that typed text is not auto-capitalized or auto-corrected.
3. Tap the field again and confirm select-on-focus.

cases.title: Keyboard does not obscure password field or Sign in button
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen on the iOS simulator with software keyboard enabled.

cases.title: Login fields and buttons are operable with VoiceOver and meet tap-target size

cases.steps:

cases.title: Backgrounding then foregrounding keeps the session and refreshes
cases.preconditions: Signed in, on Today.
cases.steps:

2. Foreground the app.
3. Pull to refresh on Today.
cases.expectedResult: App resumes on Today (not Login). If the access token entered the proactive-refresh window while backgrounded, the next refresh tick / data fetch silently refreshes it. No flicker back to the auth gate beyond the brief hydration spinner.

cases.feature: Token expiry mid-session on a write
cases.title: Expired access token during an authenticated write is recovered or surfaced
cases.preconditions: Signed in. Access token will expire/be revoked while the app is open but the refresh token is still valid.
cases.steps:

2. Perform an authenticated write (e.g. submit an order draft or save a voice note).
3. Observe the result and the next refresh tick.
cases.expectedResult: If the write fires with an expired token the API returns 401 (PulseApiError, surfaced as an error state); the periodic refresh (interval + proactive window) obtains a new token and a retry of the action succeeds. The user is not logged out as long as the refresh token is valid (only a true 401/403 on refresh forces re-login).

cases.title: Slow connection shows Signing in... and does not double-submit
cases.preconditions: On the Login screen with valid credentials. Use Network Link Conditioner (or a throttling proxy) to simulate a slow link.

3. While the request is in flight, tap 'Sign in' repeatedly.
cases.expectedResult: Button shows 'Signing in...' and is disabled (canSubmit gated by !isSigningIn), so repeated taps do not fire duplicate /auth/login requests. On success it navigates to Today; on timeout/network failure the ErrorState shows the failure and the button re-enables for retry.

cases.title: Director overview link appears in More for a Regional Director
cases.preconditions: Signed in on the iOS simulator as a user whose role is REGIONAL_DIRECTOR (QA-E2E-rd@dynamicaqs.test). App built and pointed at https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com.

cases.expectedResult: A 'Director overview' section title and a tappable 'Director overview' MoreAction card are visible (detail: 'Pipeline health, training compliance, and consignment exceptions across your region, scoped to your book.'). Tapping it navigates to the Director overview screen.

cases.title: Director overview shows pipeline and training KPI tiles
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR with online connectivity. Region has lead and training activity.
cases.steps: 1. Tap the More tab. 2. Tap 'Director overview'. 3. Wait for the 'Loading director overview...' state to resolve. 4. Read the 'Pipeline & training' metric strip.
cases.expectedResult: Four MetricCards render: 'Open leads' (with 'N new' detail), 'Conversion' (N% / 'Lead to account'), 'Trainings (90d)' (with 'N hrs'), and 'Open exceptions'. Values are non-negative numbers scoped to the RD's book; no spinner remains.

cases.title: Cross-module exception rows display stale leads, overdue training, overdue ROSE, open consignment work
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR online; region has at least one stale lead, one overdue audit, and one open consignment work item.
cases.steps: 1. Open More > Director overview. 2. After load, locate the 'Cross-module exceptions' card. 3. Read each row value.
cases.expectedResult: Card shows four rows: 'Stale leads', 'Overdue training', 'Overdue ROSE audits', 'Open consignment work', each with a right-aligned numeric value. Rows with value >0 render the value in the warning colour; rows at 0 render in the muted colour.

cases.title: Open exceptions tile shows danger badge and 'Needs attention' when count > 0
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR online; region has at least one open exception (stale lead or overdue audit).
cases.steps: 1. Open More > Director overview. 2. After load, inspect the 'Open exceptions' MetricCard.
cases.expectedResult: When openExceptions > 0 the tile shows the count, a 'danger' badge, and detail 'Needs attention'. The count equals staleLeads + overdueTraining + overdueAudits + openConsignmentWorkItems.

cases.title: Open exceptions tile shows 'All clear' and no badge when count is zero
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a REGIONAL_DIRECTOR whose region has zero stale leads, zero overdue training, zero overdue audits, and zero open consignment work.
cases.steps: 1. Open More > Director overview. 2. After load, inspect the 'Open exceptions' MetricCard.
cases.expectedResult: Tile shows value '0', detail 'All clear', and no danger badge. All four exception rows show 0 in muted colour.

cases.title: Revenue/financial KPIs are shown as parked, not as numbers
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR online.
cases.steps: 1. Open More > Director overview. 2. After load, scroll below the exception card to the muted-surface note.

cases.title: Territory Manager does not see Director overview in More and cannot view the rollup

cases.title: Non-RD role deep-linking to /rd-dashboard sees the access EmptyState, not metrics
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a TERRITORY_MANAGER. A deep link/URL to the rd-dashboard route is available (e.g. via Safari custom scheme or `xcrun simctl openurl booted <scheme>://rd-dashboard`).
cases.steps: 1. While signed in as TM, trigger the deep link to the rd-dashboard route. 2. Observe the Director overview screen.
cases.expectedResult: The screen renders the EmptyState 'Director view — This rollup is for Regional Directors and executives.' No KPI tiles, exception rows, or reporting API data are shown. No RD-scoped reporting calls leak data to the TM.

cases.title: Executive and Super Admin roles can open the Director overview
cases.preconditions: Two test accounts available: role EXECUTIVE (QA-E2E-exec@dynamicaqs.test) and role SUPER_ADMIN (QA-E2E-admin@dynamicaqs.test).
cases.steps: 1. Sign in as EXECUTIVE, tap More, confirm 'Director overview' is present, tap it. 2. Sign out, sign in as SUPER_ADMIN, repeat.

cases.title: RD sees only their regional rollup, not another region's or another TM's records

cases.title: All three reporting endpoints failing still renders a zeroed summary plus an error banner
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR. All three endpoints (leads, training, consignment) forced to fail in a proxy.

cases.title: Opening Director overview in airplane mode shows an error and recovers on reconnect

cases.title: Loading indicator shows on first load and is replaced by the summary

cases.title: Refresh button reloads the rollup with updated counts
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR online. A change can be made server-side (e.g. complete a training or clear a stale lead) between loads.

cases.title: Lead inbox and ROSE audits shortcut buttons navigate correctly
