cases.title: Header back from Director overview returns to More
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR; reached Director overview via More.
cases.steps: 1. From More, open 'Director overview' (note the native header titled 'Director overview' with a back chevron). 2. Tap the header back chevron.
cases.expectedResult: Header shows 'Director overview' (headerShown true). Back returns to the More tab. The bottom tab bar remains usable; no orphaned/blank screen.

cases.title: Cold-start deep link to /rd-dashboard as RD lands directly on the rollup
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR with a valid stored session. App fully terminated (not backgrounded).
cases.steps: 1. Force-quit the app from the app switcher. 2. Trigger a deep link to the rd-dashboard route (e.g. `xcrun simctl openurl booted <scheme>://rd-dashboard`). 3. Wait for cold start.

cases.title: Session refresh while viewing the rollup keeps data loading; failed refresh forces re-login
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR. Access token nearing expiry; the session provider runs a periodic refresh timer.
cases.steps: 1. Open More > Director overview and leave it open past the access-token lifetime so the background refresh fires. 2. Tap 'Refresh' after the token rotation. 3. Separately, invalidate the refresh token server-side, then tap 'Refresh' again.
cases.expectedResult: After a successful background refresh the rollup still reloads with 200s. When the refresh token is invalid, resolveStoredSession fails and the app signs out (canonical 'Sign in again' state per FR-MOB-048), routing to login rather than showing stale/blank metrics.

cases.title: Backgrounding and foregrounding the rollup does not duplicate requests or lose state
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR; Director overview loaded. Network proxy capturing requests.
cases.steps: 1. With Director overview open, swipe up to the iOS home/app switcher to background the app for ~30s. 2. Reopen the app to foreground. 3. Inspect the screen and the captured requests.
cases.expectedResult: Foregrounding returns to the same Director overview with the previously loaded summary intact; no duplicate stacked in-flight loads cause flicker or stale-overwrite (requestId guard). No crash.

cases.title: Metric strip and exception card reflow on rotation and on iPad

cases.expectedResult: Each MetricCard announces its label and value (e.g. 'Open leads, 42'); the 'Open exceptions' danger state is conveyed (not colour-only); the 'Lead inbox' and 'ROSE audits' buttons announce as buttons with their labels; 'Refresh' is reachable and actionable.

cases.title: Largest Dynamic Type size keeps all KPI values and exception counts readable
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR. iOS Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Larger Text set to the maximum.
cases.steps: 1. Set the largest text size. 2. Open More > Director overview. 3. Inspect the metric tiles and exception rows.
cases.expectedResult: Labels and values scale or wrap without clipping; the tabular-nums exception values remain fully visible; no metric value is cut off or overlapped at the largest accessibility text size.

cases.title: No auth session yields no metrics and no leaked reporting calls
cases.preconditions: App reset to a signed-out state (no stored session).
cases.steps: 1. Without signing in, attempt to deep-link to the rd-dashboard route. 2. Observe the screen and captured network calls.
cases.expectedResult: With no auth, the hook short-circuits (summary stays null, no reporting fetches fire) and the user is gated to login or sees the access EmptyState; no unauthenticated reporting request is sent to pulse-crm.theclustox.com.

cases.title: Conversion rate renders as a percent and handles a zero/empty pipeline
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a REGIONAL_DIRECTOR whose region currently has no converted leads (conversionRatePct resolves to 0).
cases.steps: 1. Open More > Director overview for the empty-pipeline RD. 2. Read the 'Conversion' MetricCard.
cases.expectedResult: Conversion tile shows '0%' with detail 'Lead to account' (not blank, NaN, or 'undefined%'). No crash when lead metrics are null.

cases.title: A card number routed from the RD's region via a voice note is rejected by the API
cases.preconditions: Signed in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR. From More, the Voice notes capture is reachable. The API enforces the NFR-CIS-03 PCI guard on free-text payloads.

cases.title: Card-number in disposition note path (known PCI gap on log-initial-contact)
cases.preconditions: Signed in as TM. Lead QA-E2E-Lead-PCI (initialContactedAt null). Open its Lead Detail online.
cases.steps: 1. Open Lead Detail for QA-E2E-Lead-PCI. 2. Tap 'Log call'. 3. In the note field type a fake Luhn-valid PAN with a card prefix, e.g. 'QA-E2E paid by 4111 1111 1111 1111'. 4. Tap 'Log call to CRM'. 5. Inspect the response and whether the note persisted.
cases.testData: Note containing a fake test PAN 4111 1111 1111 1111 (NEVER a real card)
cases.expectedResult: EXPECTED per PCI policy (NFR-CIS-03): the API rejects with a payment-card message and nothing is stored. cases.steps:
1. With storage failing, open the sheet and save a route 'QA-E2E-NoPersist'.
2. Read the plan message.
cases.expectedResult: The route is kept in-memory and the message reads 'Couldn\'t persist "QA-E2E-NoPersist" (device storage issue) - kept for this session only.' No false 'Saved' confirmation. The route would be lost on app kill.

cases.title: Saved routes are capped at 25, dropping oldest-updated
cases.preconditions: Ability to create more than 25 saved routes.
cases.steps:
1. Create 26 distinct saved routes (QA-E2E-Route-01 .. QA-E2E-Route-26), updating the first one last so it is the most recently updated.
2. Reopen the sheet and count the entries.
cases.expectedResult: Only 25 routes are retained (SAVED_ROUTES_LIMIT). The oldest-updated route is dropped while surviving routes keep their original list order. No crash, no corrupt write.

cases.title: Loading a saved route whose stops are no longer loaded handles gracefully
cases.preconditions: A saved route references account ids that are NOT in the currently loaded account set (e.g. territory reassignment).
cases.steps:
1. Save a route with current accounts.
2. Force the loaded account set to differ (switch QA env / territory or refresh against a different fixture).
3. Open the sheet and tap 'Load' on that saved route.
cases.expectedResult: Only stops intersecting the loaded accounts are restored. If none intersect, the message reads 'None of "<name>"\'s N stops are in your loaded accounts - current route kept.' If some intersect, it loads the usable subset and notes how many were dropped.

cases.title: Navigate hands off a located stop to an external maps provider
cases.preconditions: Route has a located stop. Google Maps / Waze may or may not be installed (Apple Maps always available).
cases.steps:
1. On a located stop card, tap 'Navigate'.
2. In the NavigateSheet, choose a provider (Apple Maps / Google Maps / Waze).
3. Confirm the external app opens (or the https fallback opens in the browser).
cases.expectedResult: The chooser opens the selected provider deep-linked to the stop's lat/long and label; the last provider is remembered. The Navigate action is only present on located stops (no Navigate button on unlocated stops). In-app turn-by-turn is intentionally not provided (delegated externally).

cases.title: Check in at a stop captures GPS when location permission is granted
cases.preconditions: Location permission not yet decided; simulator has a custom GPS location set (Features > Location > Custom).
cases.steps:
1. On a stop card, tap 'Check in'.
2. When iOS prompts for location, tap 'Allow While Using App'.
3. Observe the active-visit card pills.
cases.expectedResult: A checked-in card appears with the account name and start time. The visit pill shows 'GPS captured' once a fix is obtained; CRM status moves pending -> CRM checked in. Move/remove and other stops' Check in are disabled while a visit is active.

cases.title: Check in proceeds timed-only when location permission is denied
cases.preconditions: Location permission for the app set to Deny (Settings > Privacy > Location, or deny at the prompt).
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Check in' on a stop.
2. At the iOS prompt, tap 'Don\'t Allow' (or pre-deny in Settings).
3. Observe the visit card and any error banner.
cases.expectedResult: The visit still starts (timed-only). The pill shows 'Timed only' instead of 'GPS captured', and an error banner reads 'Location permission was not granted. The visit can still be timed, but GPS evidence is missing.' Check-in is not blocked (BR-M-05).

cases.title: Completing a visit is blocked until checkout notes are entered
cases.preconditions: A visit is active (checked in) on a route stop.
cases.steps:
1. With the checkout notes field empty, observe the 'Complete visit' button.
2. Type a space only and confirm the button stays disabled.
3. Type real notes 'QA-E2E checkout - shelf restocked' and tap 'Complete visit'.
cases.expectedResult: 'Complete visit' is disabled while notes are empty or whitespace-only. Once non-empty notes are present it enables; tapping it completes the visit, moves it to 'Completed today', and clears the active card. Cannot check in elsewhere until checkout is done (FR-MOB-032).

cases.title: Completed visit saves as a retryable draft when offline, then syncs
cases.preconditions: A visit is active. Toggle airplane mode ON in iOS Settings before completing.
cases.steps:
1. With airplane mode ON, enter checkout notes and tap 'Complete visit'.
2. Read the sync message.
3. Turn airplane mode OFF.
4. Open Sync Status (bell / More) and tap retry on the route-visit draft.
cases.expectedResult: Offline completion saves a 'Route visit: <name>' draft (canonical 'Saved on phone' / 'Needs retry' state) rather than reporting CRM saved. The visit appears under 'Completed today'. After reconnect, retry from Sync Status submits the full payload and flips to 'CRM saved'.

cases.title: An interrupted checked-in visit is restored after app relaunch
cases.preconditions: Check in at a stop (creating a checked-in route-visit draft), then kill the app before checkout.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Check in' at a stop and let it reach checked-in.
2. Force-kill the app.
3. Relaunch, log in, open the Route tab.
cases.expectedResult: The checked-in visit is restored from the durable draft with a message like 'Checked-in visit restored from this phone. Add checkout notes and complete it here.' Notes are restored if any. The user can finish checkout normally.

cases.title: Load suggested / check-in with an expired token surfaces a sign-in prompt, not a crash
cases.preconditions: Auth token expired or session signed out (auth is null) while the Route tab is open.
cases.steps:
1. Let the access token expire (or sign out in another tab) without leaving the Route tab.
2. Tap 'Load suggested'.
3. Then attempt 'Check in' on a stop.
cases.expectedResult: Load suggested shows 'Sign in to load the server route plan.' (no crash). Check in shows 'Sign in before starting a route visit so CRM can assign the trainer correctly.' Locally-built route state (stops, dwell, saved routes) is unaffected.

cases.title: TM only sees their own assigned accounts as candidate stops
cases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM whose territory excludes accounts assigned to another TM (QA-E2E-other-tm).
cases.steps:
1. On the Route tab tap 'Add stops'.
2. Search for an account known to belong only to another TM's territory (e.g. QA-E2E-OTHER-ACC-500).
3. Also tap 'Load suggested' and inspect the candidate stops.
cases.expectedResult: Another TM's out-of-scope accounts never appear in the picker, the seeded route, or the server suggested plan (territory scoping enforced server-side, NFR-MOB-009). The TM cannot build a route over accounts they are not assigned.

cases.title: Route screen shows loading, empty, and account-load error states
cases.preconditions: Ability to delay/fail the field-data fetch (slow signal or forced error).
cases.steps:
1. Cold-open the Route tab on a slow/throttled connection and observe the loading state.
2. Remove all stops from a loaded route and observe the empty state.
3. Force the accounts fetch to error (e.g. unreachable host) and reopen.
cases.expectedResult: Loading shows 'Building route plan...'. With no stops it shows 'No stops on the route yet' with guidance to Add stops / Load suggested. A fetch error shows an ErrorState banner while the rest of the screen (hero, buttons) stays usable (degrade-independently).

cases.title: Refresh accounts and deep-link from a stop to account detail and back
cases.preconditions: Route has at least one stop with a valid account id.
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Refresh accounts' and confirm the route reconciles with the reloaded set (dropped accounts pruned, dwell entries pruned).
2. On a stop card tap 'View'.
3. Confirm navigation to the account detail screen (/account/[id]).
4. Tap the back control to return to the Route tab with the route intact.
cases.expectedResult: Refresh reloads accounts and prunes any selected ids no longer present (without blanking a freshly-mounted tab). 'View' pushes the account detail route; back returns to Route with the same stops, order, dwell, and start time preserved (shared selection store).

cases.title: Confirm road-distance/traffic ETA and true distance-optimized TSP are NOT present (known gap)
cases.preconditions: Route with several located stops. OQ-MOB-08 maps-provider decision is parked (RTE-K2).
cases.steps:
1. Tap 'Optimize order' and read the plan message and ETA copy.
2. Inspect the hero copy and the route-builder section detail.
cases.expectedResult: All optimization/ETA is explicitly straight-line ('nearest-neighbour (straight-line)', '~X mi straight-line', 'est.'). The hero/section copy states road/traffic optimization 'stays parked until the maps decision'. No real driving-time, traffic, or true TSP route is offered. This is the expected parked behaviour, not a defect.

cases.title: Confirm saved routes are local-only with no server sync or manager share-export (known gap)
cases.preconditions: A route saved on this device. A second device/account for the same TM, or a manager account.
cases.steps:
1. Save a route on device A.
2. Sign in as the same TM on device B (or as a manager) and open saved routes.
3. Look for any 'share' / 'export to manager' control on the route.
cases.expectedResult: The saved route does NOT appear on device B and there is no share/export-to-manager action (RTE-K4 parked). Routes are local-first only. This is the expected parked behaviour; log as a gap against any future server-sync expectation.

cases.title: VoiceOver labels, tap targets, and dynamic type on the route builder
cases.preconditions: Route has at least 2 stops. Enable VoiceOver and a large Dynamic Type size in iOS Settings.
cases.steps:
1. Turn on VoiceOver and swipe through the route controls and a stop card.
2. Confirm spoken labels for move up/down, remove, dwell, start-time +/-, 'Now', Navigate, View, Check in, and the colour dot.
3. Increase Dynamic Type to an accessibility size and re-inspect the cards.
cases.expectedResult: Every control exposes a descriptive accessibilityLabel (e.g. 'Move <name> up', 'Dwell N minutes at <name>, tap to change', 'Set start time to now', 'Navigate to <name>', 'Map status: <label>'). Icon buttons are 40x40 (meet ~44pt tap target with hitSlop). Text scales without truncating critical labels or overlapping; no control becomes unreachable.

cases.title: Route state survives app backgrounding and device rotation
cases.preconditions: Route built with several stops, custom dwell values, and a non-default start time; running on iPad simulator for rotation.
cases.steps:
1. Background the app (Home / app switcher) for ~30s, then foreground it.
2. Confirm the route, order, dwell, and start time are intact.
3. Rotate the simulator to landscape and back to portrait.
cases.expectedResult: After foregrounding, the in-memory route selection, dwell map, and start time are preserved (no reset, no duplicate seed). On rotation the content column re-centres/reflows without clipping the stop cards or action buttons; no crash.
